about: Qilich solutions catalogue: the source for the Solutions page and for the SamurAI advisor. Edit by hand; see solutions-README.md.

currency.uzs_rounding: below UZS 10 000 000 round to the nearest 100 000; from UZS 10 000 000 round to the nearest 1 000 000

pricing.price_includes: Project management, design, development, QA, deployment, acceptance fixes and handover.
pricing.price_excludes: Hardware, third-party licences and usage fees (hosting, AI APIs, SMS, telephony, maps, CRM or 1C licences, store fees), content production, taxes where they apply.
pricing.monthly_billing_note: When billing is 'monthly', price_usd is per month (mvp = basic plan, full = extended plan) and timeline_weeks is the time to start.

adjustments.combining_solutions: largest at 100%, each further one at 70–85% (shared backend, design and setup)

line.uz: Takroriy ishni AI oladi: mijozlarga javob, hujjatlar, hisobotlar.
line.ru: ИИ берёт на себя повторяющуюся работу: ответы клиентам, документы, отчёты.
line.en: AI takes over the repetitive work: replies to customers, documents, reports.

line.uz: Mijozlaringiz allaqachon Telegramda. Savdo, bron va xizmatni oʻsha yerga olib boramiz.
line.ru: Ваши клиенты уже в Telegram. Переносим туда продажи, запись и сервис.
line.en: Your customers are already in Telegram. We bring sales, booking and service there.

line.uz: iOS va Android ilovalari: mijozlar, kuryerlar, agentlar va xodimlar uchun.
line.ru: Приложения для iOS и Android: для клиентов, курьеров, агентов и сотрудников.
line.en: iOS and Android apps for customers, couriers, sales reps and staff.

line.uz: 3D oʻyinlar, AR va virtual turlar: mijoz brendingiz bilan vaqt oʻtkazadi.
line.ru: 3D-игры, AR и виртуальные туры: клиент проводит время с вашим брендом.
line.en: 3D games, AR and virtual tours: customers spend time with your brand.

line.uz: Saytlar, onlayn doʻkonlar va platformalar: tez, uch tilda, qidiruvda topiladi.
line.ru: Сайты, интернет-магазины и платформы: быстрые, на трёх языках, находятся в поиске.
line.en: Websites, online stores and platforms: fast, in three languages, easy to find in search.

line.uz: CRM, ERP, ombor, kassa va hujjatlar, 1C va soliq tizimlari bilan bogʻlangan.
line.ru: CRM, ERP, склад, касса и документы, связанные с 1С и налоговыми системами.
line.en: CRM, ERP, warehouse, tills and documents, connected to 1C and the tax systems.

line.uz: Datchiklar, kameralar va qurilmalar: transport, sovuq zanjir, issiqxona va sex nazoratda.
line.ru: Датчики, камеры и устройства: транспорт, холодовая цепь, теплицы и цеха под контролем.
line.en: Sensors, cameras and devices: vehicles, cold chain, greenhouses and factory floors under control.

line.uz: Oʻzbekistondagi serverlar, zaxira nusxalar va xavfsizlik tekshiruvi: tizim toʻxtamaydi.
line.ru: Серверы в Узбекистане, резервные копии и проверка безопасности: система не останавливается.
line.en: Servers in Uzbekistan, backups and security checks, so your systems keep running.

line.uz: Loyihadan oldin reja, keyin doimiy xizmat: dizayn, sinov, SLA.
line.ru: План до проекта и сервис после: дизайн, тестирование, SLA.
line.en: A plan before the project and service after it: design, testing, SLA.

line.uz: Klinika, oʻquv markazi, restoran, qurilish, agro va boshqa sohalarning oʻz jarayonlari uchun tizimlar.
line.ru: Системы под процессы клиник, учебных центров, ресторанов, стройки, агро и других отраслей.
line.en: Systems built around how clinics, education centres, restaurants, construction, farms and others actually work.

value.uz: Mijozlarga kecha-kunduz bir daqiqada oʻzbek va rus tilida javob beradi, murakkab savolni xodimga oʻtkazadi.
value.ru: Отвечает клиентам круглосуточно за минуту на узбекском и русском, сложные вопросы передаёт сотруднику.
value.en: Answers customers around the clock within a minute, in Uzbek and Russian, and hands hard cases to a person.

scope.mvp: An official Telegram Business connected bot on your company account (or a regular bot); AI answers from your FAQ, price list and policies; handover to an operator with the full conversation; daily summary of chats.
scope.full: Order and booking status lookups from your CRM or 1C; complaint logging; voice messages understood (speech-to-text); Uzbek Latin and Cyrillic plus Russian; operator panel; per-topic tone and escalation rules; weekly quality report.

solutions.notes: Telegram Business connected bots need Telegram Premium on the business account. No unofficial userbots: they break Telegram rules and get accounts banned. The AI never promises refunds, discounts or prices outside the rules you approve.

title.ru: Центр жалоб и отзывов с ИИ

value.uz: Telegram, Instagram, qoʻngʻiroq va saytdagi har bir shikoyat roʻyxatga tushadi, masʼulga yetadi va muddatida yopiladi.
value.ru: Каждая жалоба из Telegram, Instagram, звонков и с сайта попадает в реестр, доходит до ответственного и закрывается в срок.
value.en: Every complaint from Telegram, Instagram, calls and the website is logged, routed to the right person and closed on time.

scope.mvp: Intake from Telegram and a web form; AI tags topic, branch and urgency; routing to the responsible person in Telegram; SLA timers; status updates to the customer.
scope.full: Instagram and call transcripts as sources; sentiment and root-cause tags; manager dashboard by branch; repeat-issue detection; monthly trend report; link to your CRM or helpdesk.

title.en: AI voice agent for your call centre

value.uz: Kiruvchi qoʻngʻiroqlarga navbatsiz oʻzbek va rus tilida javob beradi, buyurtma oladi, qabulga yozadi, kerak boʻlsa operatorga ulaydi.
value.ru: Отвечает на входящие звонки без очереди на узбекском и русском, принимает заказы и записи, при необходимости соединяет с оператором.
value.en: Picks up incoming calls with no queue, in Uzbek and Russian, takes orders and bookings, and transfers to an operator when needed.

scope.mvp: One narrow scenario (for example booking or order status) on your existing number via SIP; speech recognition and synthesis in Uzbek and Russian; transfer to a person; recordings and transcripts of every call.
scope.full: Several scenarios; lookups in your CRM and booking system; payment links by SMS or Telegram after the call; call-reason analytics; script A/B tests; capacity for peak hours.

solutions.notes: Uzbek speech recognition is less accurate than Russian, especially with mixed speech and street noise. We test on your real call recordings and agree an accuracy target before launch.

title.uz: AI chiquvchi qoʻngʻiroqlar: eslatma, soʻrov, qarz
title.ru: Исходящие звонки ИИ: напоминания, опросы, долги
title.en: AI outbound calls: reminders, surveys, overdue payments

value.uz: Qabulni tasdiqlash, toʻlov eslatmasi va soʻrovnomalarni operatorlarsiz, bir kunda minglab mijozga yetkazadi.
value.ru: Подтверждения записей, напоминания об оплате и опросы — тысячам клиентов за день и без операторов.
value.en: Confirms appointments, reminds about payments and runs surveys for thousands of customers a day, without operators.

scope.mvp: One campaign type (for example appointment confirmation) with a fixed script; results written to your CRM; retry rules; calls only within respectful hours.
scope.full: Several campaign types; branching dialogues; promise-to-pay capture for overdue accounts; NPS surveys with free-text answers analysed; dashboard; Telegram or SMS follow-up.

solutions.notes: Calls only people who are already your customers, within legal hours, with a clear way to opt out. No cold mass dialling.

title.uz: AI savdo yordamchisi: sayt, Instagram, Telegram
title.ru: ИИ-помощник по продажам: сайт, Instagram, Telegram
title.en: AI sales assistant for website, Instagram and Telegram

value.uz: Mijozning savolidan mos mahsulotni topadi, narxni aytadi, buyurtma yoki uchrashuvni yozib, CRMga tushiradi.
value.ru: По вопросу клиента подбирает товар, называет цену, оформляет заказ или встречу и заносит всё в CRM.
value.en: Finds the right product from a customer's question, quotes the price, books the order or meeting and logs it in your CRM.

scope.mvp: One or two channels; answers from your catalogue and price list; lead qualification questions; handover to a sales manager; leads in amoCRM or Bitrix24.
scope.full: All channels (website chat, Instagram Direct, Telegram, WhatsApp if you use it); live stock and prices from 1C; follow-up messages; product recommendations; conversion report by channel and manager.

title.uz: AI hujjat ishlash: hisob-faktura, yuk xati, shartnoma
title.en: AI document processing: invoices, waybills, contracts

value.uz: Skan va fotodagi hujjatlardan maʼlumotni oʻqib, 1C yoki ERPga oʻzi kiritadi; buxgalteriya qoʻlda terishdan qutuladi.
value.ru: Считывает данные со сканов и фото документов и сам заносит их в 1С или ERP; бухгалтерия перестаёт набивать вручную.
value.en: Reads data from scanned and photographed documents and enters it into 1C or your ERP, so accounting stops retyping.

scope.mvp: Two or three document types in Uzbek and Russian; field extraction with confidence scores; check screen for low-confidence fields; export to 1C or Excel.
scope.full: Many document types and layouts; matching against purchase orders and e-invoices; duplicate and error detection; approval workflow; searchable archive; intake by email or Telegram.

title.uz: Pasport va ID-kartani oʻqish, masofaviy identifikatsiya
title.ru: Распознавание паспортов и ID-карт, удалённая идентификация
title.en: Passport and ID card reading, remote identity checks

value.uz: Pasport yoki ID-karta maʼlumoti soniyalarda anketaga tushadi; xato va soxta hujjat darhol koʻrinadi.
value.ru: Данные паспорта или ID-карты попадают в анкету за секунды, ошибки и подделки видны сразу.
value.en: Passport or ID card data fills the form in seconds, and errors and forged documents show up at once.

scope.mvp: Reading of Uzbek ID cards and passports (MRZ and visual zone); selfie liveness check and face match; result into your form or CRM; audit log.
scope.full: MyID integration where your licence allows it; foreign passports; tamper checks; operator review queue; encrypted storage in Uzbekistan; reports for the regulator.

solutions.notes: Personal data is stored on servers in Uzbekistan, as the personal data law requires.

title.ru: База знаний с ИИ для сотрудников

value.uz: Yangi xodim reglament va qoʻllanmalardan javobni bir daqiqada, manba hujjati bilan oladi va rahbarni kichik savollar bilan chalgʻitmaydi.
value.ru: Новый сотрудник за минуту получает ответ из регламентов и инструкций со ссылкой на документ и не отвлекает руководителя.
value.en: New staff get answers from your rules and manuals in a minute, with the source document, instead of asking a manager.

scope.mvp: Up to a few hundred documents (PDF, Word, Google Docs); answers in Uzbek and Russian with links to the source; access through Telegram or the web; admin uploads new documents.
scope.full: Role-based access, so staff see only what they may; sync with Google Drive or SharePoint; answer review and feedback; onboarding quizzes; list of unanswered questions to improve the documents.

solutions.notes: Can run on servers in Uzbekistan with a self-hosted model when documents must not leave the country.

title.en: AI analyst: ask your data questions

value.uz: «Oʻtgan oy Samarqandda nima yaxshi sotildi?» deb yozasiz, AI 1C va CRMdan raqam, jadval va grafik bilan javob beradi.
value.ru: Пишете «что лучше продавалось в Самарканде в прошлом месяце?», и ИИ отвечает цифрами, таблицей и графиком из 1С и CRM.
value.en: Type “what sold best in Samarkand last month?” and get the answer as numbers, a table and a chart from 1C and your CRM.

scope.mvp: Connection to one data source (1C or a copy of your database); 20–30 typical business questions tested; answers in Telegram or the web with the query shown; read-only access.
scope.full: Several sources joined (1C, POS, CRM, ads); scheduled reports in Telegram; anomaly alerts; access by role; an agreed metrics layer so the numbers match finance.

value.uz: Har bir filial va mahsulot boʻyicha keyingi haftalar savdosini koʻrsatadi: omborda ortiqcha tovar kamayadi, kerakli tovar tugab qolmaydi.
value.ru: Показывает продажи на недели вперёд по каждому филиалу и товару: меньше лишнего на складе, нужное не заканчивается.
value.en: Shows expected sales for the coming weeks per branch and product, so there is less dead stock and fewer items run out.

scope.mvp: Forecast for top products from 1–3 years of sales history; seasonality (Ramadan, Navruz, school season, wedding season); accuracy check against real sales; Excel or dashboard output.
scope.full: All products and branches; purchase suggestions with minimum stock and supplier lead times; effect of promotions and prices; weekly automatic retraining; results written back to 1C.

title.uz: Doʻkon uchun videoanalitika: tashrif, navbat, javon
title.ru: Видеоаналитика для магазинов: трафик, очереди, полки
title.en: Computer vision for stores: footfall, queues, shelves

value.uz: Mavjud kameralar orqali kirganlarni, kassadagi navbatni va boʻsh javonlarni sanaydi; menejer muammoni darhol Telegramda koʻradi.
value.ru: По существующим камерам считает посетителей, очереди у касс и пустые полки; менеджер сразу видит проблему в Telegram.
value.en: Uses your existing cameras to count visitors, queues at the tills and empty shelves, and alerts managers in Telegram.

scope.mvp: Pilot in one store; footfall and queue length from 2–6 IP cameras; alerts in Telegram; daily report; video processed on site with no faces stored.
scope.full: Chain rollout; empty-shelf detection; heatmaps; conversion (visitors against POS receipts); staff presence at counters; central dashboard.

solutions.notes: Works with common IP cameras. A small processing box per store is hardware and is quoted separately.

title.en: AI quality control on the production line

value.uz: Kamera nuqsonli mato, qadoq yoki mahsulotni liniyaning oʻzida topadi; brak mijozga yetmaydi, sababi hisobotda koʻrinadi.
value.ru: Камера находит брак ткани, упаковки или продукции прямо на линии; брак не уходит клиенту, а причина видна в отчёте.
value.en: A camera spots defective fabric, packaging or products on the line, so defects do not reach customers and their causes show in the report.

scope.mvp: One line and one or two defect types; camera and lighting setup; model trained on your samples; operator alert or reject signal; photo log of defects.
scope.full: Several lines and defect types; PLC link for automatic rejection; statistics by shift and supplier; retraining on new defects; link to MES or ERP.

solutions.notes: Accuracy depends on lighting and samples, so the pilot measures it on your real production before scaling. Industrial cameras are quoted separately.

value.uz: Kaskasiz ishchi, xavfli zonaga kirish, tutun yoki olovni kamera oʻzi koʻradi va prorabga darhol xabar beradi.
value.ru: Камера сама замечает работника без каски, вход в опасную зону, дым или огонь и сразу сообщает прорабу.
value.en: Cameras spot workers without helmets, entry into danger zones, smoke or fire, and alert the site manager at once.

scope.mvp: Helmet and vest detection plus one restricted zone on up to 8 cameras; Telegram alerts with a snapshot; daily log of violations.
scope.full: Several sites; smoke and fire detection; vehicle and people counting at gates; violation statistics per subcontractor; link to access control.

value.uz: Bir haftalik post, mahsulot tavsifi va reklama matnlarini oʻzbek va rus tilida bir soatda tayyorlaydi, siz faqat tasdiqlaysiz.
value.ru: За час готовит посты, описания товаров и рекламные тексты на неделю на узбекском и русском; вам остаётся утвердить.
value.en: Drafts a week of posts, product descriptions and ad texts in Uzbek and Russian in an hour; you just approve them.

scope.mvp: Brand voice guide set up once; drafts of posts, captions and product descriptions in Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic) and Russian; approval in Telegram; content calendar in Google Sheets.
scope.full: Image variations for posts and banners; bulk product descriptions for marketplaces; scheduled publishing to Telegram and Instagram; results feed back into the next drafts.

solutions.notes: A person approves everything before it is published.

title.uz: Oʻzbek va rus tilida AI ovoz va video
title.ru: ИИ-озвучка и видео на узбекском и русском
title.en: AI voice-over and video in Uzbek and Russian

value.uz: Oʻquv, mahsulot va reklama videolari studiya va diktorsiz bir necha kunda tayyor; matn oʻzgarsa, video ham tez yangilanadi.
value.ru: Обучающие, продуктовые и рекламные ролики за несколько дней без студии и диктора; поменялся текст — видео быстро обновляется.
value.en: Training, product and ad videos in a few days without a studio or voice actor; when the script changes, the video updates fast.

scope.mvp: Production pipeline from script to narrated video: synthetic voices in Uzbek and Russian, subtitles, brand templates; the first 5–10 videos.
scope.full: Presenter videos with a licensed synthetic avatar or your own presenter (with written consent); batch production from a spreadsheet; translations; a video library for staff training.

solutions.notes: We never copy a real person's face or voice without their written consent.

value.uz: Yuzlab rezyume va Telegram arizalardan mos nomzodlarni ajratadi, birinchi bosqich savollarini beradi va HRga qisqa xulosa yuboradi.
value.ru: Из сотен резюме и заявок в Telegram выбирает подходящих кандидатов, задаёт вопросы первого этапа и присылает HR короткую сводку.
value.en: Picks suitable candidates from hundreds of CVs and Telegram applications, asks first-round questions and sends HR a short summary.

scope.mvp: Application bot in Telegram; CV parsing; scoring against your criteria; first-round questions by text or voice; shortlist in Google Sheets or your ATS.
scope.full: Vacancy posting to hh.uz and Telegram channels; interview scheduling; mass-hiring flows for couriers and cashiers; recruiter dashboard; review of criteria for fairness.

solutions.notes: AI ranks, a person decides. Criteria are reviewed so they never filter by age, gender or ethnicity.

title.uz: Oʻzbek, rus va ingliz tillariga AI tarjima
title.en: AI translation between Uzbek, Russian and English

value.uz: Katalog, sayt va hujjatlarni uch tilga sizning atamalaringiz bilan tarjima qiladi, oʻzbek matnini lotin va kirill yozuvi orasida oʻgiradi.
value.ru: Переводит каталоги, сайты и документы на три языка с вашей терминологией и переводит узбекский текст между латиницей и кириллицей.
value.en: Translates catalogues, websites and documents into three languages with your own terms, and converts Uzbek between Latin and Cyrillic.

scope.mvp: Translation pipeline with your glossary; Latin–Cyrillic converter; upload of Word, Excel and catalogue files; review queue for a human editor.
scope.full: Link to your CMS or marketplace feeds; translation memory; checks for numbers, units and names; Telegram bot for quick translations; usage statistics.

solutions.notes: Legal and medical texts still need a professional reviewer; we build that review step in.

title.uz: Qoʻngʻiroqlar sifatini AI bilan nazorat qilish

value.uz: Barcha savdo va xizmat qoʻngʻiroqlarini matnga aylantirib tekshiradi: skript buzilishi, eʼtirozlar va qoʻldan ketgan mijozlar bitta roʻyxatda.
value.ru: Расшифровывает и проверяет все звонки продаж и сервиса: нарушения скрипта, возражения и упущенные клиенты в одном списке.
value.en: Transcribes and checks every sales and service call: script breaks, objections and lost customers in one list.

scope.mvp: Transcription of recorded calls in Uzbek and Russian; scoring against 5–10 script points; weekly report per manager.
scope.full: Processing within minutes of each call; objection and reason analytics; link to CRM deals; coaching tips per manager; search across all calls.

value.uz: Toʻlovlarni solishtirish, qarzdorlarga eslatma, CRMni yangilash kabi kundalik ishlarni bajaradi; muhim qadamni xodim tasdiqlaydi.
value.ru: Выполняет ежедневную рутину: сверку платежей, напоминания должникам, обновление CRM; важные шаги подтверждает сотрудник.
value.en: Does daily routine work such as matching payments, reminding debtors and updating the CRM, while a person approves the important steps.

scope.mvp: One process mapped and automated end to end (for example matching Click and Payme payments to orders in 1C); approval step in Telegram; log of every action.
scope.full: Several processes; agent tools for CRM, 1C, e-invoicing and email; exception queue for staff; monitoring and spending limits; monthly review of hours saved.

value.uz: Uzum Market va boshqa saytlarda xuddi shu mahsulot narxini har kuni koʻrsatadi; narxni qachon oʻzgartirish kerakligi aniq boʻladi.
value.ru: Каждый день показывает цены на те же товары на Uzum Market и других площадках; понятно, когда менять свою цену.
value.en: Shows daily prices for the same products on Uzum Market and other sites, so you know when to change yours.

scope.mvp: Daily collection from 2–3 public sources; AI matching of identical products; price table and Telegram alerts on big changes.
scope.full: More sources; price history and charts; repricing suggestions by your rules; availability tracking; export to 1C or your seller cabinet.

solutions.notes: Collects only public prices, within each site's terms and load limits.

value.uz: Shartnomani kompaniyangiz qoidalari bilan solishtiradi va xavfli bandlarni oʻzbek yoki rus tilida belgilaydi; yurist vaqti tejaladi.
value.ru: Сверяет договор с правилами вашей компании и отмечает рискованные пункты на узбекском или русском; юрист тратит меньше времени.
value.en: Compares a contract with your company's rules and flags risky clauses in Uzbek or Russian, saving your lawyer's time.

scope.mvp: Checklist of your 20–40 rules; upload in Word or PDF; report with flagged clauses and suggested wording; Uzbek and Russian.
scope.full: Template library; comparison with earlier versions; approval workflow with E-IMZO signing; contract register with deadlines and reminders.

solutions.notes: A tool for your lawyer, not legal advice.

title.uz: Oʻz serveringizdagi AI: maʼlumot Oʻzbekistonda qoladi
title.ru: ИИ на ваших серверах: данные остаются в Узбекистане
title.en: Private AI on your own servers: data stays in Uzbekistan

value.uz: Bank, klinika va davlat tashkilotlari AIdan maxfiy maʼlumotni chet elga yubormasdan foydalanadi.
value.ru: Банки, клиники и госорганизации пользуются ИИ, не отправляя конфиденциальные данные за рубеж.
value.en: Banks, clinics and public bodies use AI without sending confidential data abroad.

scope.mvp: Open-weight model deployed on your servers or in a data centre in Uzbekistan; one use case (for example an internal knowledge base); access control and logs; quality comparison with cloud models.
scope.full: Several use cases; fine-tuning on your data where it helps; GPU capacity planning; monitoring; red-team tests; documentation for auditors.

solutions.notes: GPU servers are bought or rented separately; we help size them.

value.uz: Shubhali toʻlov, kassada bekor qilingan cheklar yoki yoqilgʻi oʻgʻirligini zarar kattalashguncha topadi.
value.ru: Находит подозрительные платежи, отмены чеков на кассе или слив топлива до того, как убыток вырастет.
value.en: Finds suspicious payments, voided receipts at the till or fuel theft before the losses grow.

scope.mvp: One risk scenario; rules plus a model trained on your history; alert queue for an analyst; weekly report of caught cases.
scope.full: Real-time scoring through an API; several scenarios; case management; feedback loop for retraining; dashboards for security and finance.

title.uz: Telegram buyurtma boti: doʻkon va restoran uchun
title.ru: Telegram-бот для заказов: магазин и ресторан
title.en: Telegram ordering bot for shops and restaurants

value.uz: Mijoz katalogdan tanlaydi, Click yoki Payme bilan toʻlaydi, manzilni xaritada belgilaydi; buyurtma darhol oshxona yoki omborga tushadi.
value.ru: Клиент выбирает из каталога, платит через Click или Payme, отмечает адрес на карте; заказ сразу приходит на кухню или склад.
value.en: Customers pick from the catalogue, pay with Click or Payme and drop a pin for the address; the order goes straight to the kitchen or warehouse.

scope.mvp: Catalogue with categories and photos in Uzbek and Russian; cart; delivery or pickup; location sharing; Click and Payme payment; order notifications to a staff group; simple admin panel.
scope.full: Several branches with delivery zones on Yandex Maps; stock and prices from 1C or your POS; promo codes; order statuses for the customer; courier assignment; sales reports.

title.uz: Telegram Mini App ichida onlayn doʻkon
title.en: Online store as a Telegram Mini App

value.uz: Telegramdan chiqmasdan toʻliq doʻkon: filtrlar, mahsulot sahifalari, savat va toʻlov; ilova yuklab olish shart emas.
value.ru: Полноценный магазин, не выходя из Telegram: фильтры, карточки товаров, корзина и оплата; скачивать приложение не нужно.
value.en: A full store without leaving Telegram: filters, product pages, cart and payment, with no app to download.

scope.mvp: Mini App with catalogue, search, filters, cart and checkout with Click, Payme or Uzum; bot for order notifications; admin panel for products and orders.
scope.full: Stock sync with 1C or your marketplace cabinet; customer accounts and order history; loyalty and promo codes; recommendations; analytics; product sharing to chats; the same backend ready for a website or app later.

value.uz: Mijoz usta, shifokor yoki maydonga boʻsh vaqtga oʻzi yoziladi va eslatma oladi; administrator kun boʻyi telefonda oʻtirmaydi.
value.ru: Клиент сам записывается к мастеру, врачу или на площадку в свободное время и получает напоминание; администратор не висит на телефоне.
value.en: Customers book a stylist, doctor or sports pitch in a free slot themselves and get reminders, so staff stop living on the phone.

scope.mvp: Services, staff and schedules; booking, rescheduling and cancelling; reminders a day and an hour before; notifications to a staff group; admin panel.
scope.full: Prepayment with Click or Payme; several branches; Google Calendar sync; review request after the visit; repeat-visit reminders; no-show statistics; Mini App interface.

value.uz: Obuna toʻlovi, kanalga qoʻshish va muddat tugaganda chiqarish avtomatik; qoʻlda roʻyxat yuritish kerak emas.
value.ru: Оплата подписки, добавление в канал и удаление по окончании срока — автоматически, без ручных списков.
value.en: Subscription payments, adding members to the channel and removing them when their time runs out, all automatic, with no manual lists.

scope.mvp: Plans; payment with Click, Payme or Telegram Stars; one-time invite links; expiry reminders and removal; payment list for the owner.
scope.full: Recurring card payments where the provider supports them; promo codes and trials; several channels and groups; referral links; revenue and churn reports.

value.uz: Kichik jamoa mijozlar, bitimlar va vazifalarni toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri Telegramda yuritadi; yangi dastur oʻrganish shart emas.
value.ru: Небольшая команда ведёт клиентов, сделки и задачи прямо в Telegram, без изучения новой программы.
value.en: A small team runs customers, deals and tasks right in Telegram, without learning a new program.

scope.mvp: Mini App with contacts, deal pipeline, tasks and reminders; leads from a bot or web form; team roles; export to Excel.
scope.full: Messages to customers from the CRM through the bot; call logging; payment status from Click and Payme; reports per manager; 1C sync; a migration path to amoCRM or Bitrix24 if you outgrow it.

value.uz: Postlar jadval boʻyicha chiqadi, spam oʻchiriladi, konkurslar oʻzi oʻtadi; admin har kuni bir soat tejaydi.
value.ru: Посты выходят по расписанию, спам удаляется, конкурсы проходят сами; админ экономит час в день.
value.en: Posts go out on schedule, spam is removed and giveaways run themselves, saving the admin an hour a day.

scope.mvp: Scheduled posting with approval; anti-spam and new-member checks in groups; basic channel statistics for the owner.
scope.full: Cross-posting to several channels; giveaways with a fair random draw and subscription check; AI comment moderation; post performance report; content planned in Google Sheets.

value.uz: Ishga kelish-ketish, taʼtil arizasi, ish haqi varaqasi va eʼlonlar bitta botda; HR qogʻoz va qoʻngʻiroqlardan qutuladi.
value.ru: Отметка прихода и ухода, заявления на отпуск, расчётные листы и объявления в одном боте; у HR меньше бумаг и звонков.
value.en: Check-in and check-out, leave requests, payslips and announcements in one bot, so HR deals with fewer papers and calls.

scope.mvp: Check-in by location and selfie; leave and absence requests with manager approval; announcements; onboarding checklist for new staff.
scope.full: Payslips from 1C; shift schedules and swaps; internal surveys; training materials and tests; reports by branch; link to face-ID terminals.

title.ru: Кэшбэк и программа лояльности в Telegram

value.uz: Mijoz kassada QR-kod koʻrsatib keshbek oladi; kim qaytib kelayotganini va kimga taklif yuborish kerakligini bilasiz.
value.ru: Клиент показывает QR-код на кассе и получает кэшбэк; вы знаете, кто возвращается и кому отправить предложение.
value.en: Customers show a QR code at the till and earn cashback, and you see who comes back and whom to send an offer.

scope.mvp: Sign-up with phone number; QR card in the bot; cashback or points added by the cashier or POS; balance and history; broadcast messages.
scope.full: POS integration (iiko, R-Keeper or 1C); levels and birthday offers; referral bonuses; segments by visit frequency; campaign results report; Mini App card.

title.en: Lead quiz bot for ad traffic

value.uz: Reklamadan kelgan har kimga 3–5 ta savol berib, haqiqiy xaridorni ajratadi va raqami bilan darhol menejerga yuboradi.
value.ru: Задаёт каждому из рекламы 3–5 вопросов, выделяет настоящих покупателей и сразу передаёт менеджеру с номером телефона.
value.en: Asks everyone from your ads 3–5 questions, picks out real buyers and sends them to a manager with their number right away.

scope.mvp: Quiz with buttons; phone number request; lead card to a manager group or CRM; ad source (UTM) tracking.
scope.full: Several quizzes per campaign; follow-ups for people who stopped halfway; amoCRM or Bitrix24 pipeline; cost per lead by ad source.

title.uz: Operatorlar paneli bilan Telegram yordam xizmati
title.ru: Служба поддержки в Telegram с панелью операторов
title.en: Telegram helpdesk with an operator panel

value.uz: Bir nechta operator mijozlarga bitta botdan javob beradi; har bir murojaat raqam oladi va javobsiz qolmaydi.
value.ru: Несколько операторов отвечают клиентам из одного бота; каждое обращение получает номер и не остаётся без ответа.
value.en: Several operators answer customers from one bot; every request gets a number and none goes unanswered.

scope.mvp: A ticket per conversation; operator panel (web, or a Telegram group with topics); assignment and statuses; quick replies; customer rating after closing.
scope.full: Working hours and auto-replies; SLA timers; customer history from your CRM; AI reply suggestions; reports per operator and topic.

value.uz: Darslar, uy vazifasi va testlar toʻlovdan keyin Telegramda avtomatik ochiladi; oʻquvchi qayerda toʻxtaganini koʻrasiz.
value.ru: Уроки, домашние задания и тесты открываются в Telegram автоматически после оплаты; видно, где ученик остановился.
value.en: Lessons, homework and tests open in Telegram automatically after payment, and you see where each student stopped.

scope.mvp: Course structure with video, files and text; tests with automatic scoring; access after Click or Payme payment; progress view for the teacher.
scope.full: Homework review by teachers; lessons released on a schedule; PDF certificates; groups and cohorts; reminders to inactive students; Mini App player.

title.en: Photo report bot for field staff

value.uz: Prorab, merchendayzer yoki agent joyidan foto, geolokatsiya va izoh yuboradi; rahbar kunlik holatni bitta jadvalda koʻradi.
value.ru: Прораб, мерчендайзер или агент отправляет с места фото, геолокацию и комментарий; руководитель видит картину дня в одной таблице.
value.en: Foremen, merchandisers and sales agents send photos, location and notes from the site, and managers see the whole day in one table.

scope.mvp: Report templates by role; photo with time and location check; reports into a Google Sheet or web table; daily summary for managers.
scope.full: Checklists with required photos; offline queue for weak coverage; map of visits; AI checks of shelf photos; KPIs per employee.

title.uz: Diler va doʻkonlar uchun Telegramda ulgurji buyurtma
title.ru: Оптовые заказы в Telegram для дилеров и магазинов
title.en: Wholesale ordering in Telegram for dealers and shops

value.uz: Mijoz doʻkonlar kechasi ham buyurtma beradi, oʻz narxi va qarzini koʻradi; agentlar buyurtmani telefonda yigʻib oʻtirmaydi.
value.ru: Магазины-клиенты заказывают даже ночью и видят свои цены и долг; агентам не нужно собирать заказы по телефону.
value.en: Shop clients order even at night and see their own prices and balance, so agents stop collecting orders by phone.

scope.mvp: Mini App catalogue with each client's price list from 1C; minimum quantities; balance and credit limit; orders into 1C; notifications.
scope.full: Reconciliation statements in the bot; promotions by client segment; payment by Click, Payme or bank transfer with an invoice; e-invoices through Didox; reports by agent and region.

value.uz: Mijoz telefonida doim siz boʻlasiz: katalog, buyurtma, toʻlov va push-xabarlar; sotuv marketpleys komissiyasisiz.
value.ru: Вы всегда в телефоне клиента: каталог, заказ, оплата и push-уведомления; продажи без комиссии маркетплейса.
value.en: Your brand on the customer's phone: catalogue, ordering, payment and push notifications, with no marketplace commission.

scope.mvp: iOS and Android from one codebase (Flutter or React Native); catalogue, cart, payment with Click, Payme or Uzum; order history; push notifications; admin panel; publishing to App Store and Google Play.
scope.full: Loyalty and personal offers; stock sync with 1C; delivery tracking on a map; reviews; deep links from ads; analytics; Uzbek, Russian and English.

title.uz: Yetkazib berish: mijoz, kuryer va dispetcher ilovalari
title.ru: Доставка: приложения клиента, курьера и диспетчера
title.en: Delivery suite: customer, courier and dispatcher apps

value.uz: Buyurtma eng yaqin kuryerga tushadi, mijoz uni xaritada kuzatadi; yetkazish vaqti va kuryer haqi aniq hisoblanadi.
value.ru: Заказ уходит ближайшему курьеру, клиент видит его на карте; время доставки и оплата курьерам считаются точно.
value.en: Orders go to the nearest courier, customers track them on the map, and delivery times and courier pay are counted exactly.

scope.mvp: Customer ordering (app or Telegram); courier app with route and statuses; dispatcher web panel with a live map; delivery zones and fees; cash and Click or Payme.
scope.full: Automatic assignment and order batching; courier shifts and payouts; photo proof of delivery; Yandex Delivery as a fallback; ratings; delivery-time analytics by zone; partner panel for restaurants or stores.

value.uz: Klinika, salon yoki avtoservis tarmogʻi oʻz ilovasiga ega boʻladi: mijoz yoziladi va oldindan toʻlaydi, mutaxassis jadvalini telefonida yuritadi.
value.ru: У сети клиник, салонов или автосервисов своё приложение: клиент записывается и платит заранее, специалист ведёт расписание в телефоне.
value.en: A chain of clinics, salons or car services gets its own app: customers book and prepay, and each specialist runs their schedule on their phone.

scope.mvp: Customer app (iOS and Android) with branches, services, specialists and free slots; prepayment with Click or Payme; reminders; schedule app for specialists; admin panel.
scope.full: Memberships and service packages; reviews and ratings; waiting list for cancelled slots; promotions; link to your clinic or POS system; analytics per branch and specialist.

title.en: Mobile app for field sales reps

value.uz: Agent internet boʻlmasa ham buyurtma oladi, mijoz qarzini koʻradi, javon fotosini yuboradi; hammasi 1Cga tushadi.
value.ru: Агент принимает заказы даже без интернета, видит долг клиента, отправляет фото полки; всё попадает в 1С.
value.en: Reps take orders even offline, see each client's balance and send shelf photos, and everything lands in 1C.

scope.mvp: Android app (most reps use Android); visit plan; client list with balances from 1C; offline orders with sync; GPS check-in; photo reports.
scope.full: Van sales with receipt printing; returns; promotions and targets per rep; supervisor app with a map; KPI dashboard; self-ordering app for client shops; iOS version if needed.

title.ru: Приложения для банков, платёжных и микрофинансовых организаций

value.uz: Kartalar, oʻtkazmalar, toʻlovlar va kreditlar bitta xavfsiz ilovada; mijoz filialga bormaydi.
value.ru: Карты, переводы, платежи и кредиты в одном защищённом приложении; клиенту не нужно ехать в отделение.
value.en: Cards, transfers, payments and loans in one secure app, so customers do not need to visit a branch.

scope.mvp: Onboarding with MyID; Humo and Uzcard card linking; P2P transfers and bill payments through your processing partner; history; push and SMS one-time codes; security baseline (certificate pinning, root detection, encryption).
scope.full: Loans and deposits; installment purchases; cashback; in-app chat support; fraud signals; penetration test; reporting hooks for the regulator; backend for high load.

solutions.notes: The licence and the processing contract stay with your organisation; we build to your security policy and Central Bank requirements.

title.uz: Taʼlim ilovasi: video darslar, testlar, natijalar
title.en: Education app: video lessons, tests, progress

value.uz: Oʻquvchilar darsni telefonda oflayn ham koʻradi, testlar avtomatik tekshiriladi, ota-ona natijani koʻradi.
value.ru: Ученики смотрят уроки в телефоне даже офлайн, тесты проверяются автоматически, родители видят результаты.
value.en: Students watch lessons on their phones even offline, tests mark themselves and parents see the results.

scope.mvp: Courses with video, protected playback and offline download; tests; progress; payment with Click or Payme; admin panel for teachers.
scope.full: Live classes; homework with teacher review; timed mock exams in IELTS or SAT style; parent accounts; points and streaks; certificates; analytics per group.

solutions.notes: Running cost depends mostly on video storage and streaming.

title.en: Super app: many services in one app

value.uz: Kompaniyalar guruhi, bank yoki shahar xizmatlari bitta ilovaga yigʻiladi; mijoz bir marta roʻyxatdan oʻtadi va hamma joyda toʻlaydi.
value.ru: Группа компаний, банк или городские сервисы собираются в одном приложении; клиент регистрируется один раз и платит везде.
value.en: A group of companies, a bank or city services come together in one app: customers sign up once and pay everywhere.

scope.mvp: Core app with single sign-on (OneID or MyID); wallet or linked cards; the first 2–3 services; mini-app framework for adding services later; admin and content management.
scope.full: Many services built by several teams; partner SDK and review process; loyalty across services; personalisation; architecture for high load; security audit.

value.uz: Viloyat taksi xizmati yoki korporativ transport oʻz ilovasiga ega boʻladi: yoʻlovchi, haydovchi va dispetcher uchun.
value.ru: Своё приложение для регионального такси или корпоративного транспорта: для пассажира, водителя и диспетчера.
value.en: Your own app for a regional taxi service or corporate transport, with apps for passengers, drivers and dispatchers.

scope.mvp: Passenger and driver apps; fares by distance and time; live map; cash and card payment; dispatcher panel for phone orders.
scope.full: Zone and peak pricing; driver balances and commissions; scheduled and corporate rides; ratings and a safety button; intercity and parcel modes; analytics.

title.uz: Tekshiruv va audit uchun checklist ilova
title.ru: Приложение чек-листов для проверок и аудита
title.en: Checklist app for inspections and audits

value.uz: Filial, obyekt yoki uskunani qogʻozsiz tekshirish: foto, vaqt va joy bilan; kamchilik vazifaga aylanadi va bajarilishi kuzatiladi.
value.ru: Проверки филиалов, объектов и оборудования без бумаги: с фото, временем и местом; нарушения превращаются в задачи с контролем.
value.en: Paperless inspections of branches, sites and equipment, with photos, time and place; issues become tasks that are tracked to closure.

scope.mvp: Checklist builder; Android and iOS app with offline mode; photo evidence; scoring; PDF report; corrective-action tasks.
scope.full: Audit scheduling; signed reports with E-IMZO; trends per branch and inspector; QR codes on equipment; link to your ERP or helpdesk.

title.uz: Tadbirlar uchun chipta va kirish nazorati
title.ru: Билеты и контроль входа на мероприятия

value.uz: Chiptalar onlayn sotiladi, kirishda QR-kod telefon bilan tekshiriladi; qalbaki va takroriy chipta oʻtmaydi.
value.ru: Билеты продаются онлайн, на входе QR-код проверяется телефоном; поддельные и повторные билеты не проходят.
value.en: Tickets sell online and QR codes are scanned with a phone at the door, so fake and reused tickets do not get in.

scope.mvp: Event pages with ticket types or zones; checkout with Click or Payme; QR tickets by Telegram and email; scanner app for staff; sales dashboard.
scope.full: Seat maps; promo codes and partner sales; refunds; badges for conferences; accounts for several organisers; load testing for big on-sale moments.

title.en: Services marketplace: repairs, cleaning, home services

value.uz: Mijoz ustani reyting va narx boʻyicha tanlaydi, usta buyurtmani telefonida oladi, siz har bir buyurtmadan komissiya olasiz.
value.ru: Клиент выбирает мастера по рейтингу и цене, мастер получает заказ в телефоне, вы берёте комиссию с каждого заказа.
value.en: Customers choose a pro by rating and price, the pro gets the job on their phone, and you earn a commission on every order.

scope.mvp: Customer app, provider app and admin panel; categories; requests and offers; chat; ratings; Click or Payme payments with commission accounting.
scope.full: Provider verification with documents and MyID; payment holds through your payment partner; dispute handling; subscriptions for providers; promotion tools; analytics.

title.uz: Tarmoq uchun sodiqlik ilovasi va platformasi
title.ru: Приложение и платформа лояльности для сети
title.en: Loyalty app and platform for chains

value.uz: Barcha filiallarda bitta raqamli karta: keshbek, darajalar va shaxsiy takliflar; qaysi aksiya oʻzini oqlaganini raqamlarda koʻrasiz.
value.ru: Одна цифровая карта во всех филиалах: кэшбэк, уровни и персональные предложения; в цифрах видно, какая акция окупилась.
value.en: One digital card across all branches with cashback, tiers and personal offers, and numbers that show which promotion paid off.

scope.mvp: iOS and Android app with a digital card and QR; points or cashback rules; integration with one POS system; push campaigns; admin panel.
scope.full: Segments and personal offers; Apple Wallet and Google Wallet cards for people without the app; partner programmes; fraud limits; campaign return reports; the same programme in a Telegram bot.

value.uz: iOS va Android uchun 3D oʻyin: gʻoyadan sinov chiqarilishigacha; daromad reklama va oʻyin ichidagi xaridlardan.
value.ru: 3D-игра для iOS и Android от идеи до тестового запуска; доход от рекламы и внутриигровых покупок.
value.en: A 3D game for iOS and Android, from idea to test launch, earning from ads and in-app purchases.

scope.mvp: Game design document; Unity prototype; one polished level or core loop (vertical slice); basic monetisation; analytics; soft launch in test markets.
scope.full: Launch content (levels, characters, progression); live-ops tools; ad mediation and in-app purchases; leaderboards; localisation; performance on low-end Android phones; store launch and first updates.

solutions.notes: Art style drives cost more than code. The ranges assume stylised 3D, not photorealism.

value.uz: Tez oʻrganiladigan oddiy oʻyin bir necha oyda chiqadi va reklamadan daromad keltiradi.
value.ru: Простая игра, которую легко освоить, выходит за несколько месяцев и зарабатывает на рекламе.
value.en: A simple game that is quick to learn, shipped in a few months and earning from ads.

scope.mvp: One core mechanic; 10–20 levels or an endless mode; ad integration; analytics; store publishing.
scope.full: Progression and daily rewards; in-app purchases; A/B tests of difficulty and ads; more content; localisation.

value.uz: Mijoz brendingiz bilan bir necha daqiqa oʻynaydi, sovgʻa yutadi va kontaktini qoldiradi; aksiya natijasi raqamlarda koʻrinadi.
value.ru: Клиент несколько минут играет с вашим брендом, выигрывает приз и оставляет контакт; результат акции виден в цифрах.
value.en: Customers play with your brand for a few minutes, win prizes and leave their contact, and the campaign results show in numbers.

scope.mvp: Browser or Telegram game in your brand style; leaderboard; prize codes; sign-up by phone number; basic anti-cheat; campaign landing page.
scope.full: Codes from packaging; several levels or weekly challenges; prize draw with a verifiable random; CRM export; load testing for TV and outdoor ad peaks.

title.en: Gamified loyalty: missions, prize wheel, badges

value.uz: Mijozlar topshiriq bajarish uchun tez-tez qaytadi: haftada uch xarid, yangi filial, doʻstini taklif qilish.
value.ru: Клиенты возвращаются чаще, чтобы выполнить задания: три покупки в неделю, новый филиал, приглашение друга.
value.en: Customers come back more often to complete missions: three purchases a week, a new branch, inviting a friend.

scope.mvp: Missions engine with 5–10 mission types; prize wheel; badges; inside your app or a Telegram Mini App; rules driven by purchase data.
scope.full: Seasons and streaks; team challenges; reward budget control; A/B tests of missions; fraud checks; retention analytics.

value.uz: Ilova yuklamasdan Telegramning oʻzida oʻynaladigan oʻyin; doʻstlar taklifi orqali auditoriyangiz tez oʻsadi.
value.ru: Игра прямо в Telegram без скачивания; аудитория быстро растёт через приглашения друзей.
value.en: A game played right in Telegram with no download, and an audience that grows fast through friend invites.

scope.mvp: Mini App game (tap, quiz, runner or puzzle); referral system; leaderboard; rewards; bot for notifications.
scope.full: Tasks with partner channels; Telegram Stars purchases; protection against bots; seasonal events; admin panel; analytics.

solutions.notes: No crypto token schemes and no promises of earning money by tapping.

title.ru: AR: товар у вас дома в реальном размере
title.en: AR product viewer: see it in your room

value.uz: Mijoz mebel, gilam yoki texnikani telefon kamerasi orqali uyida haqiqiy oʻlchamda koʻradi; qaytarishlar kamayadi.
value.ru: Клиент видит мебель, ковёр или технику у себя дома через камеру телефона в реальном размере; возвратов меньше.
value.en: Customers see furniture, rugs or appliances at real size in their own room through the phone camera, so fewer items come back.

scope.mvp: WebAR viewer that needs no app, for up to 20 products; 3D models from your photos or CAD files; button on product pages; view analytics.
scope.full: Pipeline for the whole catalogue; colour and size variants; try-on for glasses or cosmetics where it fits; ARKit and ARCore in your app; add to cart from AR.

solutions.notes: 3D modelling is priced per product, roughly $50–300 each depending on detail.

title.uz: Qadoq, afisha va bilbordlar uchun AR
title.ru: AR для упаковки, афиш и билбордов
title.en: AR for packaging, posters and billboards

value.uz: Telefonni qadoq yoki afishaga qaratsangiz, animatsiya, oʻyin yoki chegirma ochiladi; oddiy reklama jonlanadi.
value.ru: Наведите телефон на упаковку или афишу, и откроется анимация, игра или скидка; обычная реклама оживает.
value.en: Point a phone at the pack or poster to open an animation, a game or a discount, and plain print comes to life.

scope.mvp: WebAR experience on one marker (pack, poster or billboard) opened by QR code; 3D animation; call to action; scan analytics.
scope.full: Several markers; face effects in the browser; a mini-game in AR; prize codes; sharing; campaign dashboard.

value.uz: Bolalar oʻzbek tili, matematika va ingliz tilini oʻyin orqali oʻrganadi; ota-ona va oʻqituvchi natijani koʻradi.
value.ru: Дети учат узбекский язык, математику и английский через игру; родители и учитель видят результат.
value.en: Children learn Uzbek, maths and English through play, and parents and teachers see the progress.

scope.mvp: One subject; 20–40 mini-games or levels; Uzbek voice-over; progress tracking; parent screen; offline play on Android tablets.
scope.full: Several subjects and ages; teacher dashboard for classes; adaptive difficulty; subscription; Russian and English versions; content tools for methodologists.

value.uz: Xodim qimmat uskuna yoki xavfli vaziyatni avval virtual muhitda mashq qiladi; avariya va buzilishlar kamayadi.
value.ru: Сотрудник сначала тренируется на дорогом оборудовании или в опасной ситуации в виртуальной среде; аварий и поломок меньше.
value.en: Staff practise on expensive equipment or dangerous situations in a virtual setting first, so there are fewer accidents and breakdowns.

scope.mvp: One training scenario in 3D for PC or a VR headset; step checks and a mistakes log; instructor screen; Uzbek and Russian voice.
scope.full: Library of scenarios; exam mode with certificates; multi-user drills; LMS integration; headset fleet management.

solutions.notes: VR headsets are bought separately.

value.uz: Mijoz mehmonxona, kvartira, zavod yoki Samarqand obidalarini uyidan turib aylanib chiqadi va oldindan bron qiladi.
value.ru: Клиент обходит гостиницу, квартиру, завод или памятники Самарканда, не выходя из дома, и бронирует заранее.
value.en: Customers walk through a hotel, an apartment, a factory or the sights of Samarkand from home, and book in advance.

scope.mvp: 360° shoot of up to 20 points; web tour with hotspots, floor plans and contact buttons; works on phones; embedded on your site.
scope.full: Several locations; 3D model of an unbuilt property from drawings; guided audio tour in three languages; VR headset mode; booking integration; analytics.

title.uz: Koʻrgazma va tadbirlar uchun interaktiv instalyatsiyalar
title.ru: Интерактивные инсталляции для выставок и мероприятий
title.en: Interactive installations for exhibitions and events

value.uz: Stendingizda sensorli ekran, harakatga javob beradigan oʻyin yoki katta ekranda viktorina: odamlar toʻxtaydi va kontakt qoldiradi.
value.ru: Сенсорный экран, игра на движение или викторина на большом экране у вашего стенда: люди останавливаются и оставляют контакты.
value.en: A touch screen, a motion game or a big-screen quiz at your stand: people stop and leave their contacts.

scope.mvp: One interactive experience (touch, motion or quiz) for a screen or kiosk; lead capture; branded content; on-site setup support.
scope.full: Multi-screen or projection setup; photo booth with sharing to Telegram; leaderboard; content reusable at later events; analytics.

value.uz: Uch tilda tez ochiladigan, Google va Yandexda topiladigan sayt; arizalar toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri CRMga tushadi.
value.ru: Быстрый сайт на трёх языках, который находят в Google и Яндексе; заявки попадают прямо в CRM.
value.en: A fast site in three languages that people find on Google and Yandex, with enquiries going straight into your CRM.

scope.mvp: Up to 8 page types; Uzbek, Russian and English; CMS for your team; forms to Telegram or CRM; basic SEO; analytics; hosting setup.
scope.full: Custom design system; news and vacancies; product catalogue; dealer or tender section; structured data; under 2 seconds to load on mobile; accessibility checks.

title.uz: Mahsulot yoki aksiya uchun landing sahifa
title.en: Landing page for a product or campaign

value.uz: Reklamadan kelgan odam bitta sahifada hammasini tushunadi va ariza qoldiradi; har bir ariza qayerdan kelgani koʻrinadi.
value.ru: Человек из рекламы понимает всё на одной странице и оставляет заявку; видно, откуда пришла каждая заявка.
value.en: Visitors from your ads understand everything on one page and leave a request, and you see where each request came from.

scope.mvp: One page in up to three languages; lead form to Telegram or CRM; ad source (UTM) tracking; fast loading; analytics events.
scope.full: Custom illustrations or 3D; A/B variants; calculator or quiz; several campaign versions from one template.

value.uz: Kechayu kunduz sotadigan doʻkon: Click, Payme, Uzum va muddatli toʻlov, 1Cdagi qoldiq va yetkazib berish.
value.ru: Магазин, который продаёт круглосуточно: Click, Payme, Uzum и рассрочка, остатки из 1С и доставка.
value.en: A store that sells around the clock, with Click, Payme, Uzum and installments, stock from 1C and delivery.

scope.mvp: Catalogue with filters and search; cart and checkout; Click, Payme and Uzum; delivery zones; order management; stock and price sync with 1C; SEO basics.
scope.full: Installment options such as Uzum Nasiya; customer accounts; promotions; reviews; marketplace feeds; abandoned-cart messages; analytics; readiness for sale-day traffic.

value.uz: Sotuvchilar oʻz kabinetida tovar qoʻshadi, siz komissiya olasiz; toʻlov, yetkazish va hisob-kitob avtomatik.
value.ru: Продавцы добавляют товары в своём кабинете, вы получаете комиссию; оплата, доставка и расчёты идут автоматически.
value.en: Sellers list products from their own accounts, you earn a commission, and payments, delivery and settlements run automatically.

scope.mvp: Buyer website, seller cabinet and admin; product moderation; orders split by seller; commission accounting; payout report; Click and Payme.
scope.full: Mobile apps; seller analytics and paid promotion; logistics integration; returns and disputes; ratings; search tuned for Uzbek and Russian; e-invoices for B2B sellers.

title.uz: Mehmonxona va turlar uchun bron qilish moduli
title.ru: Модуль бронирования для гостиниц и туров
title.en: Booking engine for hotels and tours

value.uz: Mehmon toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri saytingizda bron qilib, toʻlaydi; agregatorlarga kamroq komissiya ketadi.
value.ru: Гость бронирует и оплачивает прямо на вашем сайте; агрегаторам уходит меньше комиссии.
value.en: Guests book and pay directly on your website, so less commission goes to aggregators.

scope.mvp: Availability calendar; rates and seasons; booking with prepayment (Click, Payme, Visa/Mastercard); confirmations by email and Telegram; admin for rooms or tours.
scope.full: Channel sync with Booking.com and others; promo codes; several currencies; extras such as transfers and excursions; reviews; reports.

value.uz: Mijozlar buyurtma, hisob-faktura, solishtirish dalolatnomasi va qarzini oʻzi koʻradi; menejerlarga savollar kamayadi.
value.ru: Клиенты сами видят заказы, счета-фактуры, акты сверки и долг; вопросов к менеджерам меньше.
value.en: Clients see their own orders, invoices, reconciliation statements and balance, so managers get fewer questions.

scope.mvp: Login for client companies; orders and statuses; documents from 1C; balance and reconciliation; support requests.
scope.full: Online ordering with client prices; e-invoices through Didox or Faktura.uz; E-IMZO signing; user roles inside each client company; notifications; API for large clients.

value.uz: Oʻquv markazi yoki kompaniya kurslarni onlayn oʻtkazadi: darslar, testlar, sertifikatlar va toʻlov bir joyda.
value.ru: Учебный центр или компания проводит курсы онлайн: уроки, тесты, сертификаты и оплата в одном месте.
value.en: An education centre or a company runs courses online, with lessons, tests, certificates and payment in one place.

scope.mvp: Courses, modules and lessons with video and files; tests; student and teacher roles; payment with Click or Payme; certificates.
scope.full: Corporate mode with departments and required courses; webinars; homework review; gradebook; mobile app or PWA; SCORM import; reports for HR.

value.uz: Xaridor saytda bino, qavat va kvartirani tanlaydi, narx va boʻlib toʻlash jadvalini koʻradi, bron qiladi; sotuv boʻlimiga tayyor ariza keladi.
value.ru: Покупатель выбирает на сайте дом, этаж и квартиру, видит цену и график рассрочки и бронирует; отдел продаж получает готовую заявку.
value.en: Buyers pick the building, floor and flat on your site, see the price and installment plan and reserve it, and sales get a ready request.

scope.mvp: Interactive facades and floor plans; filters by rooms, area and price; flat pages with layouts; availability from a spreadsheet or CRM; reservation request.
scope.full: Live sync with your sales CRM; installment calculator; 3D views of the complex; online reservation with prepayment; favourites and comparison; demand analytics by floor and layout.

value.uz: Mijoz oshxona, mebel, eshik yoki darvozani rangi va oʻlchami bilan 3Dda yigʻadi va narxini darhol koʻradi; menejer aniq buyurtma oladi.
value.ru: Клиент собирает кухню, мебель, двери или ворота в 3D с цветом и размерами и сразу видит цену; менеджер получает точный заказ.
value.en: Customers put together a kitchen, furniture, a door or a gate in 3D with colours and sizes and see the price at once; sales get an exact order.

scope.mvp: WebGL configurator for one product family; options and materials; live price from your rules; PDF summary; request to CRM.
scope.full: Several product lines; AR view; production export (cutting lists, bill of materials); dealer mode with their own prices; order creation in 1C.

value.uz: Skroll bilan harakatlanadigan 3D sahna brendingizni eslab qolinadigan qiladi, sayt esa telefonlarda ham tez ochiladi.
value.ru: 3D-сцена, которая движется при прокрутке, делает бренд запоминающимся, а сайт при этом быстро открывается и на телефонах.
value.en: A 3D scene that moves as you scroll makes your brand memorable, while the site still loads fast on phones.

scope.mvp: Art direction; one hero 3D scene or object drawn in code (Three.js); scroll-driven story; light version for weak devices; three languages.
scope.full: Several scenes; sound design; custom shaders; interactive moments or a product configurator; performance budget per device class; share images; analytics.

value.uz: Saytingiz Google va Yandexda oʻzbekcha va ruscha soʻrovlar boʻyicha yuqoriga chiqadi va telefonlarda tez ochiladi.
value.ru: Сайт поднимается в Google и Яндексе по узбекским и русским запросам и быстро открывается на телефонах.
value.en: Your site climbs on Google and Yandex for Uzbek and Russian searches and opens fast on phones.

scope.mvp: Technical audit; keyword research in Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic) and Russian; fixes for speed, indexing, structure and hreflang; Search Console and Yandex Webmaster set up.
scope.full: Three to six months of work: content plan and page templates; structured data; Google Business Profile and Yandex Maps listings; monthly report on traffic and leads.

solutions.notes: Nobody can honestly guarantee search positions; we report on traffic and leads.

value.uz: Telefonga oʻrnatiladigan, oflayn ishlaydigan va push yuboradigan veb-ilova: ikkita alohida ilovadan arzonroq va tezroq.
value.ru: Веб-приложение, которое ставится на телефон, работает офлайн и отправляет push: дешевле и быстрее двух отдельных приложений.
value.en: A web app that installs on the phone, works offline and sends push notifications, cheaper and faster than two separate native apps.

scope.mvp: Responsive app with offline cache; install prompt; push notifications; login by phone number; core features agreed in discovery.
scope.full: Background sync; payments; camera and location features; packaging for Google Play if needed; analytics.

value.uz: Gʻoyangiz obunali onlayn xizmatga aylanadi: koʻp mijozli arxitektura, tariflar va toʻlov bilan; birinchi pullik foydalanuvchilar bir necha oyda.
value.ru: Ваша идея становится онлайн-сервисом по подписке с мультиклиентской архитектурой, тарифами и оплатой; первые платящие пользователи через несколько месяцев.
value.en: Your idea becomes a subscription online service with multi-tenant architecture, plans and billing, and first paying users within months.

scope.mvp: Discovery; the core workflow; accounts and organisations; plans and payments (Click and Payme locally, Stripe or Paddle abroad through your entity); admin; onboarding emails.
scope.full: Roles and permissions; integrations; public API; usage analytics; several languages; security practices ready for enterprise buyers; scaling.

title.uz: Eʼlonlar portali: koʻchmas mulk, avto, ish

value.uz: Odamlar eʼlon joylaydi va qidiradi, siz pullik koʻtarish va bizneslar uchun tariflardan daromad olasiz.
value.ru: Люди размещают и ищут объявления, вы зарабатываете на платных поднятиях и тарифах для бизнеса.
value.en: People post and search listings, and you earn from paid boosts and business plans.

scope.mvp: Listings with photos; categories and filters; search in Uzbek and Russian; map view; user accounts; moderation; paid boosts through Click or Payme.
scope.full: Mobile apps; business accounts with bulk upload; chat between users; fraud and duplicate detection; saved searches with Telegram alerts; SEO landing pages.

value.uz: Mijoz kredit, sugʻurta, yuk tashish yoki taʼmir narxini saytda oʻzi hisoblaydi va tayyor hisob bilan murojaat qiladi.
value.ru: Клиент сам считает на сайте стоимость кредита, страховки, перевозки или ремонта и обращается с готовым расчётом.
value.en: Customers work out the cost of a loan, insurance, freight or a renovation on your site and contact you with the numbers ready.

scope.mvp: One calculator with your formulas; embedded on your site; result sent to Telegram or CRM together with the contact.
scope.full: Several calculators; branded PDF quote; prices managed in a spreadsheet or admin; A/B tests; analytics.

value.uz: Eski sayt yangi koʻrinish va tezlik oladi, qidiruvdagi oʻrinlar va havolalar esa yoʻqolmaydi.
value.ru: Старый сайт получает новый вид и скорость, а позиции в поиске и ссылки сохраняются.
value.en: Your old site gets a new look and speed without losing its search rankings and links.

scope.mvp: Audit of the current site and its traffic; new design on a modern CMS; content migration; redirect map; launch with monitoring.
scope.full: Content rewritten in three languages; new sections; integrations; accessibility; Latin and Cyrillic versions; training for editors.

title.uz: CRM joriy qilish: amoCRM, Bitrix24 yoki maxsus
title.ru: Внедрение CRM: amoCRM, Bitrix24 или своя
title.en: CRM setup: amoCRM, Bitrix24 or custom

value.uz: Har bir qoʻngʻiroq va ariza CRMga tushadi va yoʻqolmaydi; rahbar savdo voronkasi va menejerlar ishini real vaqtda koʻradi.
value.ru: Каждый звонок и заявка попадают в CRM и не теряются; руководитель видит воронку и работу менеджеров в реальном времени.
value.en: Every call and enquiry lands in the CRM and none get lost; the owner sees the sales funnel and each manager's work in real time.

scope.mvp: Process mapping; amoCRM or Bitrix24 set up with pipelines and fields; Telegram, Instagram, website and telephony connected; basic automation; staff training.
scope.full: A custom CRM when the boxed ones do not fit; 1C integration; payment status from Click and Payme; contract generation; dashboards; interface in Uzbek for staff.

solutions.notes: Running cost here is mostly CRM licences, which depend on the number of users.

title.uz: ERP: ishlab chiqarish va savdo uchun yagona tizim
title.ru: ERP: единая система для производства и торговли
title.en: ERP: one system for production and trade

value.uz: Xarid, ishlab chiqarish, ombor, savdo va moliya bitta tizimda; rahbar haqiqiy tannarx va foydani har kuni koʻradi.
value.ru: Закупки, производство, склад, продажи и финансы в одной системе; руководитель каждый день видит реальную себестоимость и прибыль.
value.en: Purchasing, production, warehouse, sales and finance in one system, so the owner sees true cost and profit every day.

scope.mvp: Process discovery; core modules for the biggest pain first (for example production orders, materials and warehouse); integration with 1C accounting; roles; reports.
scope.full: All modules (purchasing, production planning, quality, sales, finance); cost calculation; shop-floor mobile apps; BI; e-invoicing; migration from spreadsheets and old systems.

solutions.notes: Often the right answer is to extend 1C rather than replace it; discovery decides.

title.en: 1C integration with websites, bots, marketplaces and banks

value.uz: Qoldiq, narx, buyurtma va toʻlovlar 1C bilan oʻzi almashinadi; xodimlar maʼlumotni bir dasturdan boshqasiga koʻchirmaydi.
value.ru: Остатки, цены, заказы и оплаты сами синхронизируются с 1С; сотрудники не переносят данные из программы в программу.
value.en: Stock, prices, orders and payments sync with 1C on their own, so staff stop copying data between programs.

scope.mvp: One integration flow (for example stock and prices to the website or bot, orders back into 1C); exchange log; error alerts.
scope.full: Several systems connected through one integration service; Click and Payme payments matched to orders; marketplaces; bank statements; monitoring dashboard.

title.en: Warehouse system (WMS): barcodes, bins, stock counts

value.uz: Har bir tovar qaysi yacheykada turganini tizim biladi; terishdagi xatolar kamayadi, inventarizatsiya bir necha barobar tezlashadi.
value.ru: Система знает, в какой ячейке каждый товар; ошибок сборки меньше, инвентаризация в разы быстрее.
value.en: The system knows which bin every item is in, so picking errors drop and stock counts take a fraction of the time.

scope.mvp: Receiving, putaway, picking and shipping with Android barcode terminals; bin locations; stock counts; sync with 1C.
scope.full: Wave and batch picking; batch and expiry control; digital marking codes; cross-docking; staff productivity; billing for 3PL clients; several warehouses.

value.uz: Kassada savdo tez, chek soliq talablariga mos, Click va Payme QR orqali toʻlov; barcha filiallar savdosi bitta hisobotda.
value.ru: Быстрые продажи на кассе, чек по требованиям налоговой, оплата по QR Click и Payme; продажи всех филиалов в одном отчёте.
value.en: Fast checkout, receipts that meet tax rules, Click and Payme QR payments, and sales from every branch in one report.

scope.mvp: POS app for tablets or touch terminals; catalogue and barcodes; online cash register and fiscal module integration; Click and Payme QR and card terminals; shifts and cash reports.
scope.full: Central management of many branches; promotions; loyalty; returns; inventory; restaurant mode (tables, kitchen printers); offline mode; export to 1C.

solutions.notes: Fiscal rules change; at the start we check the current soliq.uz requirements and certified fiscal modules.

title.uz: HR va ish haqi: davomat, tabel, hisob-kitob
title.ru: HR и зарплата: учёт времени, табель, расчёт
title.en: HR and payroll: attendance, timesheets, pay

value.uz: Davomat Face ID terminal yoki telefondan oʻzi yoziladi, tabel va ish haqi bir tugmada, ishbay haq ham aniq hisoblanadi.
value.ru: Учёт времени сам ведётся с Face ID-терминалов или телефона, табель и зарплата одной кнопкой, сдельная оплата тоже считается точно.
value.en: Attendance is logged from face-ID terminals or phones, and timesheets and pay, piece rates included, take one click.

scope.mvp: Employee records; attendance from terminals or a Telegram bot; shifts; timesheet; salary calculation by your rules; export to 1C or bank payroll.
scope.full: Piece-rate pay from production data; bonuses and penalties; leave and sick days; recruitment pipeline; HR documents signed with E-IMZO; self-service app for staff.

solutions.notes: Tax and contribution rules are set with your accountant and updated when the law changes.

value.uz: Shartnoma, buyruq va arizalar qogʻozsiz kelishiladi va E-IMZO bilan imzolanadi; qaysi hujjat kimda turib qolgani koʻrinadi.
value.ru: Договоры, приказы и заявки согласуются без бумаги и подписываются E-IMZO; видно, у кого застрял документ.
value.en: Contracts, orders and requests are approved without paper and signed with E-IMZO, and you see who is holding each document.

scope.mvp: Document types and routes; approval chains; E-IMZO signing; search and archive; Telegram notifications for approvers.
scope.full: Templates filled with data automatically; deadlines and escalation; outgoing documents through Didox; registry; audit log; approvals from the phone.

value.uz: Hisob-faktura va dalolatnomalar 1C yoki ERPdan oʻzi chiqadi, imzolanadi va solishtiriladi; buxgalter qoʻlda takror kiritmaydi.
value.ru: Счета-фактуры и акты сами формируются из 1С или ERP, подписываются и сверяются; бухгалтер не вводит их повторно.
value.en: Invoices and acts are generated from 1C or your ERP, signed and matched automatically, so accountants stop entering them twice.

scope.mvp: Outgoing e-invoices from your system through an operator API (Didox or Faktura.uz); E-IMZO signing; status tracking.
scope.full: Incoming invoices matched to purchases; acts and waybills; mismatch alerts; VAT reconciliation report; marking codes in invoices.

value.uz: Savdo, pul, ombor va reklama bitta ekranda va har ertalab Telegramda; qaror Excel yigʻilishini kutib turmaydi.
value.ru: Продажи, деньги, склад и реклама на одном экране и каждое утро в Telegram; решения не ждут сводной в Excel.
value.en: Sales, cash, stock and ads on one screen and in Telegram every morning; decisions no longer wait for an Excel summary.

scope.mvp: Up to 10 key metrics from 1–2 sources (1C, POS or CRM); web dashboard; daily Telegram summary.
scope.full: More sources (ads, marketplaces, bank); drill-down by branch, product and manager; targets and alerts; a data warehouse underneath; access by role.

value.uz: Mijoz navbatni Telegram yoki terminaldan oladi, qancha kutishini biladi va tashqarida kutishi mumkin; zalda tartib, xodimlar yuklamasi koʻrinadi.
value.ru: Клиент берёт талон в Telegram или в терминале, знает время ожидания и может подождать снаружи; в зале порядок, загрузка сотрудников видна.
value.en: Customers take a ticket in Telegram or at a terminal, know the wait and can wait outside; the hall stays calm and staff load is visible.

scope.mvp: Ticket terminal software; Telegram queue; operator screens; hall display with voice calls in Uzbek and Russian; daily statistics.
scope.full: Pre-booked time slots; priority rules; several branches; SMS notifications; service-time analytics; customer rating after service.

solutions.notes: Terminals, displays and printers are quoted separately, or we reuse the ones you have.

value.uz: Mijoz kioskda buyurtma beradi va karta yoki QR bilan toʻlaydi; kassadagi navbat qisqaradi, oʻrtacha chek oshadi.
value.ru: Клиент заказывает в киоске и платит картой или по QR; очередь на кассе короче, средний чек выше.
value.en: Customers order at a kiosk and pay by card or QR, so till queues shrink and the average order grows.

scope.mvp: Kiosk app (ordering or check-in) for one location; menu or service catalogue with photos; card terminal and Click or Payme QR; receipt printing; link to the kitchen or staff.
scope.full: Upsell suggestions; three languages; central content management for every kiosk; remote monitoring; loyalty login; accessibility mode.

solutions.notes: Kiosk hardware usually costs $1,500–5,000 per unit and is quoted separately.

value.uz: Barcha filiallardagi menyu va reklama ekranlari bitta paneldan yangilanadi; narx oʻzgarsa, bir daqiqada hamma joyda oʻzgaradi.
value.ru: Меню-борды и рекламные экраны во всех филиалах обновляются из одной панели; цена меняется везде за минуту.
value.en: Menu boards and ad screens in every branch update from one panel; change a price and it changes everywhere in a minute.

scope.mvp: Player app for Android TV or mini PCs; web panel with playlists and schedules; menu boards from your POS prices; offline playback.
scope.full: Screen groups by region; proof-of-play reports; content by time of day or weather; ad slots for partners; remote health checks.

value.uz: Xarid soʻrovlari kelishiladi, yetkazib beruvchilar narxni portalda beradi; eng yaxshi taklif tanlanadi va hammasi hujjatlanadi.
value.ru: Заявки на закупку согласуются, поставщики подают цены на портале; выбирается лучшее предложение, всё задокументировано.
value.en: Purchase requests are approved, suppliers submit prices on a portal, the best offer wins and everything is on record.

scope.mvp: Purchase requests with an approval chain; supplier registry; requests for quotes with a comparison table; purchase orders into 1C.
scope.full: Supplier portal with documents and ratings; contracts and deadlines; budget control; matching with e-invoices; savings analytics.

title.uz: Servis xizmati: arizalar va ustalar ilovasi
title.ru: Сервисная служба: заявки и приложение мастеров
title.en: Field service: requests and technician app

value.uz: Mijoz arizasi eng yaqin ustaga tushadi, usta yoʻl, ehtiyot qism va ish fotosini ilovada qayd etadi; muddat buzilsa rahbar darhol biladi.
value.ru: Заявка клиента уходит ближайшему мастеру, мастер фиксирует дорогу, запчасти и фото работ в приложении; о сорванном сроке руководитель узнаёт сразу.
value.en: Requests go to the nearest technician, who logs travel, parts and photos in the app, and managers know at once when a deadline slips.

scope.mvp: Request intake by phone, Telegram and web; dispatcher board; Android technician app with statuses, photos and customer signature; SLA timers.
scope.full: Parts stock in vans; planned maintenance; customer portal and ratings; route optimisation; pay by completed jobs; billing through 1C.

value.uz: Uzum Market va Yandex Marketdagi qoldiq, narx va buyurtmalar 1C bilan oʻzi yangilanadi; ortiqcha sotuv va qoʻlda yuklash yoʻq.
value.ru: Остатки, цены и заказы на Uzum Market и Яндекс Маркете обновляются вместе с 1С сами; без перепродаж и ручных выгрузок.
value.en: Stock, prices and orders on Uzum Market and Yandex Market update with 1C automatically, with no overselling or manual uploads.

scope.mvp: One marketplace connected through its seller API; stock and price sync from 1C; orders into 1C; error alerts in Telegram.
scope.full: Several marketplaces; bulk product card management with AI-written descriptions; unit economics per product after commissions; returns; reports.

title.ru: Цифровая маркировка: интеграция с Asl belgisi

value.uz: Markirovka kodlarini buyurtma qilish, agregatsiya, sotuv va hisobot tizimning oʻzida; qoʻlda ish va jarima xavfi kamayadi.
value.ru: Заказ кодов маркировки, агрегация, продажа и отчётность в системе; меньше ручной работы и риска штрафов.
value.en: Ordering marking codes, aggregation, sales and reporting all inside your system, with less manual work and lower risk of fines.

scope.mvp: Code ordering and status tracking through the national marking system API; printing; scanning at shipment; links to 1C documents.
scope.full: Aggregation into boxes and pallets; scanners on the production line; acceptance at the warehouse; withdrawal at sale through the POS; reconciliation reports.

solutions.notes: Product groups and deadlines are set by government decrees; we check which ones apply to you.

title.uz: Obuna va kommunal xizmatlar uchun billing
title.ru: Биллинг для подписок и коммунальных услуг

value.uz: Har oy minglab mijozga hisob chiqadi, Click va Payme orqali toʻlov qabul qilinadi, qarzdorlarga eslatma ketadi; buxgalteriya Excelsiz ishlaydi.
value.ru: Каждый месяц тысячам клиентов выставляются счета, оплата принимается через Click и Payme, должникам уходят напоминания; бухгалтерия обходится без Excel.
value.en: Bills go out to thousands of customers every month, payments come in through Click and Payme, and debtors get reminders, all without Excel.

scope.mvp: Customer accounts and tariffs; monthly invoicing; payment by account number through Click and Payme; balances; Telegram and SMS reminders.
scope.full: Meter-based billing; penalties and discounts; customer portal; suspension rules; e-invoices for companies; management reports.

title.uz: SMS, Telegram va push xabarlar markazi
title.en: SMS, Telegram and push notification hub

value.uz: Barcha xabarlar bitta xizmat orqali: avval arzon Telegram yoki push, yetib bormasa SMS; xarajat kamayadi, yetkazilgani koʻrinadi.
value.ru: Все сообщения через один сервис: сначала дешёвый Telegram или push, если не дошло — SMS; расходы ниже, доставка видна.
value.en: All messages go through one service: cheap Telegram or push first, then SMS if that fails, so costs drop and delivery is visible.

scope.mvp: One API for all your systems; templates in Uzbek and Russian; SMS through Eskiz or Play Mobile; Telegram bot channel; delivery reports; one-time codes.
scope.full: Fallback rules by cost; push for your apps; scheduled campaigns with opt-out; budgets per department; analytics.

solutions.notes: Running cost excludes per-message SMS fees, which you pay the SMS provider.

title.uz: Toʻlov integratsiyasi: Click, Payme, Uzum, Humo, Uzcard
title.ru: Интеграция платежей: Click, Payme, Uzum, Humo, Uzcard
title.en: Payment integration: Click, Payme, Uzum, Humo, Uzcard

value.uz: Mijoz oʻziga qulay usulda toʻlaydi, toʻlov buyurtmaga oʻzi bogʻlanadi; kunlik solishtirish bir necha daqiqa oladi.
value.ru: Клиент платит удобным способом, оплата сама привязывается к заказу; ежедневная сверка занимает минуты.
value.en: Customers pay the way they like, each payment links itself to the order, and daily reconciliation takes minutes.

scope.mvp: One or two providers (for example Click and Payme) in your site, app or bot; payment statuses; refunds; test and live setup with the provider.
scope.full: All major providers and card acquiring; recurring payments and saved cards where available; split payments; reconciliation report; installment providers.

solutions.notes: Merchant contracts with providers are signed by your company; we do the technical side. Provider fees are separate.

title.uz: Windows va macOS uchun desktop ilovalar
title.ru: Десктопные приложения для Windows и macOS
title.en: Desktop apps for Windows and macOS

value.uz: Internet uzilsa ham ishlaydigan, printer, tarozi va skanerlarga toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri ulanadigan dastur; operatorlar uchun tez va qulay.
value.ru: Программа, которая не зависит от интернета и напрямую подключается к принтерам, весам и сканерам; быстрая и удобная для операторов.
value.en: Software that keeps working without internet and talks directly to printers, scales and scanners, fast and comfortable for operators.

scope.mvp: Windows app (.NET, Electron or Tauri) for one workflow; local database with sync; hardware integration; automatic updates; installer.
scope.full: macOS version; role-based access; reporting; central administration; code-signing certificates; migration from old desktop software.

value.uz: Har bir mashina qayerdaligi, qancha yoqilgʻi sarflagani va qanday haydalganini koʻrasiz; yoqilgʻi oʻgʻirligi va boʻsh qatnovlar kamayadi.
value.ru: Видно, где каждая машина, сколько ушло топлива и как она ездила; меньше слива топлива и пустых рейсов.
value.en: See where each vehicle is, how much fuel it used and how it was driven, with less fuel theft and fewer empty runs.

scope.mvp: GPS trackers installed or reused; live map; trips and stops; geofences; fuel level sensors on key vehicles; Telegram alerts.
scope.full: Driver behaviour scores; maintenance schedules; planned against actual routes; links to waybills and 1C; driver app; reports per vehicle and driver.
