solutions.notes: Trackers cost roughly $40–150 each and fuel sensors more; hardware is quoted separately.

value.uz: Ombor, muzlatgich va refrijeratorlardagi harorat har daqiqada yoziladi; chegaradan chiqsa, masʼul darhol xabar oladi va mahsulot buzilmaydi.
value.ru: Температура на складе, в холодильниках и рефрижераторах пишется каждую минуту; при выходе за границы ответственный сразу получает сигнал, товар не портится.
value.en: Temperature in warehouses, fridges and reefer trucks is logged every minute, and the person in charge is alerted the moment it leaves range, before goods spoil.

scope.mvp: Wireless temperature and humidity sensors; gateway; dashboard; Telegram and SMS alerts; daily log ready for inspections.
scope.full: Truck sensors with GPS; door sensors; reports for pharmacy and food safety audits; calibration records; link to your WMS.

value.uz: Hisoblagich koʻrsatkichlari oʻzi yigʻiladi, isrof va oʻgʻirlik koʻrinadi; ijarachi va abonentlarga hisob aniq chiqadi.
value.ru: Показания счётчиков собираются сами, потери и хищения видны; арендаторы и абоненты получают точные счета.
value.en: Meter readings collect themselves, losses and theft become visible, and tenants and subscribers get accurate bills.

scope.mvp: Pilot with 50–200 meters (Modbus, M-Bus, LoRaWAN or pulse outputs); data collection; consumption dashboard; leak and anomaly alerts.
scope.full: Thousands of meters; billing integration; customer app showing consumption; tamper detection; load profiles for energy planning.

title.uz: Kirish nazorati: Face ID, QR, karta
title.ru: Контроль доступа: Face ID, QR, карты
title.en: Access control: face ID, QR codes, cards

value.uz: Ofis, zavod yoki turar-joy majmuasiga faqat ruxsati borlar kiradi; mehmonga QR-ruxsatnoma Telegramda bir daqiqada beriladi.
value.ru: В офис, на завод или в ЖК проходят только те, у кого есть доступ; гостю QR-пропуск в Telegram выдаётся за минуту.
value.en: Only people with access get into the office, factory or residential complex, and guests get a QR pass in Telegram in a minute.

scope.mvp: Integration with face-ID terminals or turnstiles; staff and resident lists; guest QR passes through Telegram; entry log.
scope.full: Several sites; vehicle access by plate recognition; time zones and roles; links to HR attendance and payroll; visitor management for reception.

title.uz: Aqlli parkovka: raqamni tanish, shlagbaum, toʻlov
title.ru: Умная парковка: распознавание номеров, шлагбаум, оплата
title.en: Smart parking: plate recognition, barriers, payment

value.uz: Mashina raqami tanilib, shlagbaum oʻzi ochiladi; toʻlov Click yoki Payme orqali, kassir va chipta kerak emas.
value.ru: Номер машины распознаётся, шлагбаум открывается сам; оплата через Click или Payme без кассира и талонов.
value.en: Plates are recognised and the barrier opens itself, with payment through Click or Payme and no cashier or paper tickets.

scope.mvp: Plate recognition cameras at entry and exit; barrier control; tariffs; payment by QR; whitelists for residents or staff; operator panel.
scope.full: Space sensors and guidance; subscriptions; several car parks; driver app or Telegram bot; revenue reports; link to mall loyalty.

value.uz: Harorat, namlik va CO₂ datchiklar boʻyicha oʻzi ushlab turiladi; egasi telefondan nazorat qiladi, hosil barqaror boʻladi.
value.ru: Температура, влажность и CO₂ держатся сами по датчикам; владелец следит с телефона, урожай стабильнее.
value.en: Temperature, humidity and CO₂ are held automatically from sensor data, the owner checks on the phone, and harvests are steadier.

scope.mvp: Sensors and controllers for one greenhouse block; rules for vents, heating and misting; mobile dashboard; Telegram alerts.
scope.full: Several blocks; fertigation control; energy tracking; crop diaries; yield against climate analytics.

title.uz: Aqlli sugʻorish va tuproq namligi nazorati
title.ru: Умный полив и контроль влажности почвы
title.en: Smart irrigation and soil moisture control

value.uz: Tomchilatib sugʻorish tuproq namligi va ob-havoga qarab yoqiladi; suv va elektr tejaladi, hosil kamaymaydi.
value.ru: Капельный полив включается по влажности почвы и погоде; вода и электричество экономятся без потери урожая.
value.en: Drip irrigation runs by soil moisture and weather, saving water and power without losing yield.

scope.mvp: Soil moisture sensors and valve controllers on a pilot plot; schedules and thresholds; pump control; mobile app.
scope.full: The whole farm; weather forecast integration; water metering per field; satellite vegetation maps; data for water-saving subsidy applications.

value.uz: Har bir stanok ishlayaptimi, turibdimi yoki buzilganmi, ekranda koʻrinadi; toʻxtash sabablari va yoʻqotilgan soatlar hisoblanadi.
value.ru: На экране видно, работает каждый станок, стоит или сломан; причины простоев и потерянные часы посчитаны.
value.en: See on screen whether each machine is running, idle or down, with downtime reasons and lost hours counted.

scope.mvp: 10–30 machines connected through PLCs or add-on sensors; status and counters; downtime reasons entered by operators; shop-floor screen.
scope.full: OEE per line and shift; energy per unit; early warning signs for maintenance; links to ERP orders; management reports.

title.uz: Klub va ijara uchun daqiqabay hisob (aqlli rozetkalar)
title.ru: Поминутный учёт для клубов и проката (умные розетки)
title.en: Per-minute billing for clubs and rentals with smart plugs

value.uz: Bilyard stoli, PlayStation yoki ijara uskunasi seans boshlanganda yoqiladi, tugaganda oʻchadi; har daqiqa hisobda, kassadan pul chiqib ketmaydi.
value.ru: Бильярдный стол, PlayStation или прокатное оборудование включается со стартом сеанса и выключается в конце; каждая минута учтена, касса не теряет.
value.en: A billiard table, a PlayStation or rental equipment switches on when a session starts and off when it ends; every minute is billed and nothing leaks from the till.

scope.mvp: Smart plugs or relays per table or console; start and stop from a tablet; tariffs by time of day; receipts; shift report.
scope.full: Prepaid accounts and bookings in Telegram; bar orders added to the bill; several venues; owner app with live occupancy; alerts when power is used without a session.

value.uz: Quyosh panellari qancha ishlab chiqargani, qancha tejalgani va qaysi biri yomon ishlayotgani bitta ekranda koʻrinadi.
value.ru: Сколько выработали солнечные панели, сколько сэкономлено и какая из них работает хуже — на одном экране.
value.en: See how much your solar panels produced, how much you saved and which one is underperforming, on one screen.

scope.mvp: Inverter and meter data collection; production against consumption dashboard; fault alerts; monthly savings report.
scope.full: Several sites; battery view; load-shifting rules; tracking of energy sold to the grid; maintenance tickets.

title.uz: Avtomatlar va moykalar uchun telemetriya va QR toʻlov
title.ru: Телеметрия и QR-оплата для автоматов и моек
title.en: Telemetry and QR payment for vending and self-service car washes

value.uz: Avtomat, suv quyish apparati yoki avtomoykada Click yoki Payme QR bilan toʻlash mumkin; qoldiq va tushum masofadan koʻrinadi.
value.ru: В автомате, водомате или на мойке самообслуживания можно платить по QR Click или Payme; остатки и выручка видны удалённо.
value.en: Pay by Click or Payme QR at a vending machine, water station or self-service car wash, and see stock and takings remotely.

scope.mvp: Controller board connected to the machine (MDB or pulse); QR payment flow; remote status; sales dashboard; alerts for errors and low stock.
scope.full: A fleet of machines; refill route planning; prices by time of day; loyalty; fiscal receipts; technician app.

title.uz: RFID va BLE orqali aktivlarni kuzatish
title.ru: Отслеживание активов по RFID и BLE
title.en: Asset tracking with RFID and BLE

value.uz: Uskuna, konteyner yoki bichilgan pachkalar qayerdaligini tizim biladi; qidirishga vaqt ketmaydi, yoʻqotishlar kamayadi.
value.ru: Система знает, где оборудование, контейнеры или пачки кроя; меньше поисков и потерь.
value.en: The system knows where equipment, containers or garment bundles are, so less time goes on searching and less goes missing.

scope.mvp: RFID or BLE tags for one asset type; readers at key points; location and movement history; stock-take in minutes.
scope.full: Several zones and sites; links to ERP or WMS; alerts when assets leave a zone; maintenance tracking; reports.

title.uz: Avtotarozini avtomatlashtirish: paxta, gʻalla, qurilish mollari
title.en: Weighbridge automation: cotton, grain, building materials

value.uz: Yuk mashinasining raqami, vazni va fotosi odam aralashuvisiz yoziladi; tarozidagi «kelishuvlar» va xatolar yoʻqoladi.
value.ru: Номер, вес и фото грузовика записываются без участия человека; «договорённости» на весах и ошибки исчезают.
value.en: Truck plate, weight and photos are recorded without human input, so “arrangements” at the scale and errors disappear.

scope.mvp: Scale indicator integration; plate recognition camera; photos at each weighing; gross, tare and net records; printed and Telegram tickets; export to 1C.
scope.full: Several scales; contracts and limits per supplier or farmer; moisture and quality lab data; payment calculation; anti-fraud checks (repeat weighing, position sensors).

title.uz: Maxsus qurilma va proshivka ishlab chiqish

value.uz: Bozorda kerakli qurilma boʻlmasa, sxema, korpus, proshivka va ilovasini prototipdan kichik partiyagacha olib boramiz.
value.ru: Если нужного устройства нет на рынке, ведём схему, корпус, прошивку и приложение от прототипа до малой серии.
value.en: If the device you need does not exist, we take the circuit, enclosure, firmware and app from prototype to a small batch.

scope.mvp: Requirements; electronics on ESP32 or STM32; firmware; 3D-printed enclosure; companion app or dashboard; 3–5 working prototypes.
scope.full: PCB design for production; certification support; over-the-air updates; coordination with a manufacturer; a batch of 100–1,000 units; device management platform.

solutions.notes: Components and manufacturing are paid separately from development.

value.uz: Fuqarolar maʼlumoti qonun talab qilganidek Oʻzbekistonda saqlanadi, sayt va ilovalar mahalliy foydalanuvchilarga tez ochiladi.
value.ru: Данные граждан хранятся в Узбекистане, как требует закон, а сайты и приложения быстро открываются у местных пользователей.
value.en: Citizens' data stays in Uzbekistan as the law requires, and your sites and apps open fast for local users.

scope.mvp: Choice of a local data centre or cloud; server setup; domain, SSL and firewall; deployment of your app; basic monitoring.
scope.full: High-availability setup across two locations; CDN for static files; backups; central logs; a written runbook; handover or ongoing management.

value.uz: Yangi versiya bir tugmada xavfsiz chiqadi; server muammosini mijozlardan oldin siz bilasiz.
value.ru: Новая версия выходит одной кнопкой и безопасно; о проблеме с сервером вы узнаёте раньше клиентов.
value.en: New versions ship with one click and safely, and you hear about server problems before your customers do.

scope.mvp: CI/CD pipeline; Docker; staging and production environments; uptime and error monitoring; alerts to Telegram.
scope.full: Infrastructure as code; Kubernetes where it is justified; zero-downtime deploys; logs and metrics (Grafana, Prometheus); secrets management; on-call runbooks.

title.uz: Tizimlarni koʻchirish va eski dasturlarni yangilash
title.ru: Миграция систем и модернизация старого ПО

value.uz: Eski server, fayl bazasi yoki chet el bulutidagi tizim ish toʻxtamasdan yangi joyga koʻchadi; maʼlumot yoʻqolmaydi.
value.ru: Система со старого сервера, файловой базы или зарубежного облака переезжает без остановки работы и без потери данных.
value.en: Systems move from an old server, a file database or a foreign cloud to a new home without downtime or data loss.

scope.mvp: Inventory of systems; migration plan; one system or database moved after a rehearsal; data verification.
scope.full: Full migration of several systems; old code refactored into maintainable services; performance tuning; old setup switched off; documentation.

title.uz: Zaxira nusxa va avariyadan keyin tiklash

value.uz: Server ishdan chiqsa yoki shifrlovchi virus kirsa ham, maʼlumotlar bir necha soatda tiklanadi; bu oldindan sinab koʻrilgan.
value.ru: Даже если сервер выйдет из строя или зайдёт шифровальщик, данные восстанавливаются за несколько часов; это проверено заранее.
value.en: Even if a server dies or ransomware strikes, data comes back within hours, and that has been tested in advance.

scope.mvp: Automated encrypted backups of databases and files, 1C included; an off-site copy in Uzbekistan; one full restore test; alerts on failed backups.
scope.full: A disaster recovery site; recovery time and data-loss targets agreed and tested every quarter; immutable backups against ransomware; runbook and staff drill.

value.uz: Sayt, ilova va serverlardagi zaif joylarni buzgʻunchilardan oldin topamiz va tuzatish rejasini beramiz.
value.ru: Находим уязвимости сайта, приложения и серверов раньше злоумышленников и даём план исправлений.
value.en: We find weak points in your site, app and servers before attackers do, and give you a plan to fix them.

scope.mvp: Scope agreed in writing; web or mobile app test against OWASP Top 10; configuration review; report with severity and fixes.
scope.full: Infrastructure and internal network test; API and business-logic testing; phishing simulation if requested; help with fixes; retest and a summary letter.

solutions.notes: Testing only with written permission from the owner of the system.

value.uz: Sekin sayt, ilova yoki maʼlumotlar bazasi tezlashadi; katta aksiya kunida tizim yiqilmaydi.
value.ru: Медленный сайт, приложение или база данных ускоряются; в день большой распродажи система не падает.
value.en: A slow site, app or database gets faster, and the system stays up on your biggest sale day.

scope.mvp: Profiling; the 10 worst bottlenecks fixed (queries, caching, images, code); before and after measurements.
scope.full: Load testing for the expected peak; autoscaling; database replication; CDN; a performance budget checked in CI.

value.uz: 1C, kassa, CRM va reklamadagi maʼlumotlar bitta omborga yigʻiladi; raqamlar barcha hisobotlarda bir xil chiqadi.
value.ru: Данные из 1С, касс, CRM и рекламы собираются в одно хранилище; цифры во всех отчётах совпадают.
value.en: Data from 1C, tills, CRM and ads is gathered in one warehouse, so the numbers match in every report.

scope.mvp: Warehouse on ClickHouse or PostgreSQL; pipelines from 2–4 sources; data model for sales and stock; daily refresh; data quality checks.
scope.full: Many sources; updates within minutes; historical snapshots; metric definitions agreed with finance; access control; the base for AI and forecasting.

title.ru: Соответствие закону о персональных данных (техническая часть)

value.uz: Mijozlar maʼlumoti qayerda va kimda turgani aniq boʻladi, Oʻzbekistonga koʻchiriladi va himoyalanadi; tekshiruvga tayyor turasiz.
value.ru: Становится ясно, где и у кого хранятся данные клиентов; они переносятся в Узбекистан и защищаются, и вы готовы к проверке.
value.en: You know where customer data lives and who can see it, it moves to Uzbekistan and is protected, and you are ready for an inspection.

scope.mvp: Data map of your systems and vendors; gap list against the localisation requirement; consent texts reviewed together with your lawyer; plan of priority fixes.
scope.full: Personal data moved to servers in Uzbekistan; access control and logs; retention and deletion rules; help registering databases in the state register; staff guide.

solutions.notes: We do the technical work; legal opinions come from your lawyer or a partner law firm.

title.uz: Kirish va identifikatsiya: OneID, MyID, SSO, 2FA
title.ru: Вход и идентификация: OneID, MyID, SSO, 2FA
title.en: Login and identity: OneID, MyID, SSO, 2FA

value.uz: Foydalanuvchilar OneID orqali bir bosishda kiradi, xodimlar bitta login bilan barcha tizimlarga; akkauntni oʻgʻirlash qiyinlashadi.
value.ru: Пользователи входят через OneID в один клик, сотрудники одним логином во все системы; угнать аккаунт становится сложнее.
value.en: Users sign in with OneID in one click, staff use one login for every system, and accounts become much harder to steal.

scope.mvp: OneID login for your site or app (once your organisation is approved), or single sign-on for staff systems; two-factor authentication.
scope.full: MyID biometric verification where you are licensed for it; E-IMZO signing; role management; session security; audit logs.

title.ru: Снижение расходов на серверы и облако

value.uz: Hosting va bulut uchun oylik toʻlov sifat pasaymasdan kamayadi; tejalgan summa hisobotda koʻrinadi.
value.ru: Ежемесячный счёт за хостинг и облако снижается без потери качества; сэкономленная сумма видна в отчёте.
value.en: Your monthly hosting and cloud bill goes down without loss of quality, and the savings show in the report.

scope.mvp: Review of bills and usage; quick wins (unused resources, right-sizing, storage tiers); savings estimate.
scope.full: Architecture changes for long-term savings; move to cheaper local hosting where it suits; budgets and alerts; monthly review.

value.uz: Xodimlar domeningizdagi pochta, umumiy kalendar va hujjatlar bilan ishlaydi; ketgan xodim bilan maʼlumot ketib qolmaydi.
value.ru: Сотрудники работают с почтой на вашем домене, общим календарём и документами; данные не уходят вместе с уволившимся.
value.en: Staff work with email on your own domain, shared calendars and documents, and data stays when people leave.

scope.mvp: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 or self-hosted mail; domain records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC); accounts and groups; mailbox migration.
scope.full: Shared drives and permissions; device policies; two-factor login for everyone; joiner and leaver checklists; staff training.

solutions.notes: Licences are paid per user to the provider.

value.uz: Sayt, ilova, bot va hamkorlar bitta ishonchli backendga ulanadi; yangi kanal qoʻshish oylar emas, haftalar oladi.
value.ru: Сайт, приложение, бот и партнёры подключаются к одному надёжному бэкенду; новый канал добавляется за недели, а не месяцы.
value.en: Your site, app, bot and partners connect to one reliable backend, so adding a new channel takes weeks, not months.

scope.mvp: API design; core services and database; authentication; admin panel; OpenAPI documentation; tests; deployment.
scope.full: Partner API with keys and limits; webhooks; event queue; high availability; monitoring; versioning; SDK examples.

value.uz: Tizim ishga tushgandan keyin qarovsiz qolmaydi: javob vaqti shartnomada, yangilanish va tuzatishlar har oy.
value.ru: Система не остаётся без присмотра после запуска: время реакции в договоре, обновления и исправления каждый месяц.
value.en: Your system is not left alone after launch: response times in the contract, updates and fixes every month.

scope.mvp: Basic plan: support in Tashkent business hours; response within 4 working hours on critical issues; monitoring; security updates; 10–20 hours of fixes a month; monthly report.
scope.full: Extended plan: 24/7 for critical incidents with a 30–60 minute response; a named engineer; small improvements every month; quarterly kaizen review; on-call for your peak events.

solutions.notes: For systems built by another team we start with a short audit.

value.uz: Oldingi jamoa tashlab ketgan yoki tugata olmagan loyihani qabul qilib olamiz, barqaror ishlatamiz va oxiriga yetkazamiz.
value.ru: Берём проект, который бросила или не смогла закончить прежняя команда, стабилизируем его и доводим до конца.
value.en: We take over a project the previous team abandoned or could not finish, stabilise it and see it through.

scope.mvp: Access and code handover; audit of code, infrastructure and security; list of critical fixes; production stabilised; an honest verdict: fix or rewrite.
scope.full: Fixes and refactoring; tests; documentation; missing features finished; a maintainable setup; then regular support.

value.uz: Xatolarni mijozlar emas, testchilar topadi: har bir reliz oldidan qoʻlda va avtomatik sinov.
value.ru: Ошибки находят тестировщики, а не клиенты: ручные и автотесты перед каждым релизом.
value.en: Testers find the bugs, not your customers: manual and automated tests before every release.

scope.mvp: Test plan; manual testing of key flows on real Android and iOS phones common in Uzbekistan; bug reports; release checklist.
scope.full: Automated UI and API tests in CI; regression suite; load tests; accessibility checks; ongoing QA as a monthly service.

value.uz: Mijozlaringiz ilova yoki saytda adashmaydi: tadqiqot, prototip va uch tilda ishlaydigan dizayn tizimi.
value.ru: Клиенты не теряются в приложении или на сайте: исследование, прототип и дизайн-система, которая работает на трёх языках.
value.en: Customers do not get lost in your app or site: research, prototypes and a design system that works in three languages.

scope.mvp: Interviews with 5–8 users; user flows; clickable prototype of the key screens; visual style; usability test.
scope.full: Full set of screens; design system in Figma with components; Uzbek, Russian and English copy that fits the layouts; accessibility; handoff to developers.

title.en: Discovery: the plan before the build

value.uz: Bir-ikki haftada aniq reja olasiz: nima quriladi, qancha turadi va qaysi tartibda; ish taxmin bilan boshlanmaydi.
value.ru: За одну-две недели вы получаете точный план: что строим, сколько это стоит и в каком порядке; работа не начинается наугад.
value.en: In one or two weeks you get a precise plan: what gets built, what it costs and in what order, so no work starts on guesses.

scope.mvp: Workshops with your team; process map; MVP scope; architecture sketch; fixed-price estimate for the MVP; list of risks.
scope.full: All of the above plus user interviews, a clickable prototype, a technical specification, a 6–12 month roadmap and a budget by phase.

value.uz: Pudratchi topshirgan kodni yoki sotib olmoqchi boʻlgan tizimingizni mustaqil tekshiramiz; pul toʻlashdan oldin haqiqiy holatni bilasiz.
value.ru: Независимо проверяем код от подрядчика или систему, которую вы покупаете; до оплаты вы знаете реальное положение дел.
value.en: We independently check code from a contractor or a system you plan to buy, so you know the real state before you pay.

scope.mvp: Code and architecture review; quick security scan; licence check of components; short report with risks and the estimated cost to fix them.
scope.full: Deep review with load and security tests; interviews with the vendor's team; due-diligence report for investors or the board.

value.uz: Oʻz IT boʻlimingizni yigʻmasdan, Toshkentdagi tayyor jamoa mahsulotingiz ustida har kuni ishlaydi.
value.ru: Без найма своего IT-отдела: готовая команда в Ташкенте каждый день работает над вашим продуктом.
value.en: No need to hire an IT department: a ready team in Tashkent works on your product every day.

scope.mvp: One full-time developer with code review by a team lead and QA support; weekly plan and report.
scope.full: A team of 3–6 (developers, QA, designer, project manager); two-week sprints; demos; delivery metrics.

title.ru: CTO на частичную занятость и техконсалтинг

value.uz: Texnik direktor yollamasdan toʻgʻri texnik qaror qabul qilasiz: arxitektura, pudratchilar, byudjet va jamoa.
value.ru: Правильные технические решения без найма технического директора: архитектура, подрядчики, бюджет и команда.
value.en: Make the right technical decisions without hiring a CTO: architecture, contractors, budget and team.

scope.mvp: Basic plan, 2–4 hours a week: architecture decisions, reviews of vendor estimates, hiring help, a monthly tech report to the owner.
scope.full: Extended plan, 1–2 days a week: roadmap and budget, team leadership, oversight of security and compliance, preparation for investor technical due diligence.

title.uz: App Store va Google Playga chiqarish, ASO
title.ru: Публикация в App Store и Google Play, ASO
title.en: App Store and Google Play publishing, ASO

value.uz: Ilovangiz doʻkonlarga rad etilmasdan chiqadi va qidiruvda topiladi; Oʻzbekiston kompaniyasi nomiga akkaunt ochishda yordam beramiz.
value.ru: Приложение выходит в сторы без отказов и находится в поиске; помогаем открыть аккаунт разработчика на узбекскую компанию.
value.en: Your app gets into the stores without rejections and shows up in search, and we help open developer accounts for an Uzbek company.

scope.mvp: Guidance on developer accounts (D-U-N-S number, Apple and Google); store listings in three languages; screenshots; privacy forms; submission and review handling.
scope.full: Store keyword research (ASO); A/B tests of store graphics; rating prompts; release management; review monitoring.

solutions.notes: Store fees (Apple $99 a year, Google $25 once) are paid by your company.

title.uz: Xodimlarni yangi tizimga oʻrgatish va hujjatlar

value.uz: Yangi tizim chang bosib qolmaydi: xodimlar oʻzbek yoki rus tilida oʻrganadi, video qoʻllanmalar doim qoʻl ostida.
value.ru: Новая система не простаивает: сотрудники учатся на узбекском или русском, видеоинструкции всегда под рукой.
value.en: Your new system actually gets used: staff learn in Uzbek or Russian, with video guides always at hand.

scope.mvp: Training sessions on site in Tashkent or online; quick-start guides; recorded videos.
scope.full: Courses by role; knowledge tests; knowledge base articles; train-the-trainer for your key users; follow-up session a month later.

value.uz: Yozilish, elektron tibbiy karta, kassa va tahlil natijalari bitta tizimda; bemor natijani Telegramda oladi, shifokor qogʻozga vaqt sarflamaydi.
value.ru: Запись, электронная медкарта, касса и результаты анализов в одной системе; пациент получает результат в Telegram, врач не тратит время на бумаги.
value.en: Booking, electronic medical records, payments and lab results in one system; patients get results in Telegram and doctors spend less time on paperwork.

scope.mvp: Schedules and online booking (web and Telegram); patient records; visit notes with templates; cashier with fiscal receipts; lab results to Telegram; data hosted in Uzbekistan.
scope.full: Lab analyser and equipment integration; medicine stock; doctor pay by services; insurance and corporate clients; patient app; analytics by doctor and service; AI call reminders.

title.uz: Oʻquv markazi, xususiy maktab va bogʻcha tizimi
title.ru: Система для учебного центра, частной школы и детсада
title.en: System for education centres, private schools and kindergartens

value.uz: Lidlar, guruhlar, davomat, toʻlovlar va oʻqituvchilar haqi bir joyda; ota-ona dars qoldirilgani va qarz haqida darhol Telegramda biladi.
value.ru: Лиды, группы, посещаемость, оплаты и зарплата учителей в одном месте; родители сразу узнают в Telegram о пропусках и долгах.
value.en: Leads, groups, attendance, payments and teacher pay in one place, and parents hear about missed lessons and dues in Telegram right away.

scope.mvp: Leads and trial lessons; groups and timetable; attendance from the teacher's phone; payments with Click or Payme and debts; parent Telegram bot; basic reports.
scope.full: Several branches; teacher pay by hours or students; exam results and progress; marketing source analytics; homework and materials; parent mobile app.

title.uz: Restoran uchun tizim: QR-menyu, oshxona, yetkazish
title.ru: Система для ресторана: QR-меню, кухня, доставка
title.en: Restaurant suite: QR menu, kitchen display, delivery

value.uz: Mehmon stoldan QR orqali buyurtma berib, toʻlaydi, buyurtma oshxona ekraniga tushadi; ofitsiantni kutish va xatolar kamayadi.
value.ru: Гость заказывает и платит по QR со стола, заказ сразу на экране кухни; меньше ожидания официанта и ошибок.
value.en: Guests order and pay by QR at the table, the order appears on the kitchen screen, and there is less waiting and fewer mistakes.

scope.mvp: QR menu with photos in three languages; table ordering; Click or Payme payment and tips; kitchen display; integration with your POS (iiko or R-Keeper).
scope.full: Own delivery with Telegram ordering and couriers; aggregator orders (Yandex Eats, Uzum Tezkor) on one screen; loyalty; table booking; food cost and stock; owner dashboard.

value.uz: Xonalar, bronlar va toʻlovlar Booking.com bilan avtomatik bogʻlangan bitta tizimda; xorijiy mehmonlarni roʻyxatga olish tezlashadi.
value.ru: Номера, брони и оплаты в одной системе, связанной с Booking.com; регистрация иностранных гостей быстрее.
value.en: Rooms, bookings and payments in one system linked to Booking.com, with faster registration of foreign guests.

scope.mvp: Room inventory and calendar; bookings from the front desk and the website; check-in and check-out; payments and invoices; guest data ready for E-mehmon registration; housekeeping statuses.
scope.full: Channel manager (Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia); dynamic rates; restaurant and minibar charges to the room; Telegram concierge for guests; owner reports; several properties.

solutions.notes: Direct E-mehmon integration depends on the access the system grants; otherwise we prepare the data for quick manual entry.

title.en: Tour operator system and guide app

value.uz: Turlar, guruhlar, mehmonxona va transport bronlari bitta tizimda; sayyoh Samarqand, Buxoro va Xiva boʻyicha gidni oʻz tilida telefonida tinglaydi.
value.ru: Туры, группы, брони гостиниц и транспорта в одной системе; турист слушает гида по Самарканду, Бухаре и Хиве на своём языке в телефоне.
value.en: Tours, groups, hotel and transport bookings in one system, and tourists hear a guide to Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva in their own language on their phone.

scope.mvp: Tour packages and departures; bookings from the website and agents; supplier bookings (hotels, transport, guides); invoices and payments; trip documents.
scope.full: B2B portal for agents with commissions; audio guide app in several languages with offline maps; visa support workflow; feedback; profit per tour.

value.uz: Har bir dala, ekin, ish va xarajat xaritada; sunʼiy yoʻldosh suratlari muammoli maydonni oldindan koʻrsatadi, hosil va tannarx aniq hisoblanadi.
value.ru: Каждое поле, культура, работа и затраты на карте; спутниковые снимки заранее показывают проблемные участки, урожай и себестоимость считаются точно.
value.en: Every field, crop, operation and cost on a map; satellite images flag problem areas early, and yield and cost are counted exactly.

scope.mvp: Field registry with contours; crop plans; work logs from a mobile app or Telegram; inputs (seed, fertiliser, fuel); satellite vegetation index (NDVI) per field.
scope.full: Contracts and advances with farmers in a cluster; harvest intake through the weighbridge; machinery GPS; irrigation data; cost per hectare and per tonne; reports for banks and the ministry.

title.uz: Qadoqlash sexi, sovuq ombor va eksport kuzatuvi
title.ru: Упаковочный цех, холодильный склад и прослеживаемость экспорта
title.en: Packhouse, cold storage and export traceability

value.uz: Meva-sabzavotning har bir partiyasi daladan chegaragacha kuzatiladi; xaridor soʻragan sifat va kelib chiqish hujjati bir bosishda tayyor.
value.ru: Каждая партия фруктов и овощей отслеживается от поля до границы; документы о качестве и происхождении для покупателя готовы в один клик.
value.en: Every batch of fruit and vegetables is traced from field to border, with quality and origin documents for the buyer ready in one click.

scope.mvp: Batch intake with grades; QR-coded labels; cold room locations and temperatures; packing output; shipment documents.
scope.full: Settlements with farmers; lab quality results; export documents per destination; buyer portal with traceability; yield and loss analytics.

title.uz: Tikuv va toʻqimachilik ishlab chiqarishi nazorati

value.uz: Bichishdan qadoqlashgacha har bir pachka QR-kod bilan kuzatiladi; ishbay haq aniq, xorijiy buyurtmachi holatni har kuni koʻradi.
value.ru: Каждая пачка кроя отслеживается по QR-коду от раскроя до упаковки; сдельная оплата точная, иностранный заказчик каждый день видит статус.
value.en: Every cut bundle is tracked by QR code from cutting to packing, piece-rate pay is exact, and foreign buyers see order status daily.

scope.mvp: Orders and styles; cutting tickets with QR bundles; operations scanned by workers on phones or terminals; piece-rate pay; daily output dashboard.
scope.full: Line balancing and planning; quality checkpoints with defect codes; fabric and trims stock; buyer portal; cost per garment; export documents.

value.uz: Smeta va haqiqiy xarajat, materiallar, pudratchilar va ish fotolari bir joyda; pul va vaqt qayerda yoʻqolayotgani koʻrinadi.
value.ru: Смета и фактические затраты, материалы, подрядчики и фото работ в одном месте; видно, где теряются деньги и время.
value.en: Estimates against actual costs, materials, subcontractors and progress photos in one place, showing where money and time are lost.

scope.mvp: Projects and work breakdown; estimate import from Excel; foreman app or Telegram bot for daily reports and photos; material requests and deliveries; budget against actual.
scope.full: Subcontractor acts and payments; on-site warehouse; Gantt schedule with delays; equipment hours; documents signed with E-IMZO; reports for investors.

title.uz: Quruvchilar uchun sotuv tizimi: shaxmatka, bron, boʻlib toʻlash
title.ru: Система продаж застройщика: шахматка, бронь, рассрочка
title.en: Developer sales system: unit board, reservations, installments

value.uz: Har bir kvartira holati real vaqtda, shartnoma va boʻlib toʻlash jadvali bir bosishda; toʻlov kechiksa, mijoz ham, menejer ham eslatma oladi.
value.ru: Статус каждой квартиры в реальном времени, договор и график рассрочки в один клик; при просрочке напоминание получают и клиент, и менеджер.
value.en: Real-time status of every flat, a contract and installment schedule in one click, and reminders to buyer and manager when a payment is late.

scope.mvp: Unit board (shakhmatka) by building and floor; reservations with expiry; price lists; contract generation; installment schedules; payment tracking.
scope.full: CRM integration; buyer cabinet with payments through Click or Payme; mortgage applications to banks; agent commissions; sync with the website apartment picker; sales analytics.

title.uz: Turar-joy majmuasi, biznes markaz va bozor boshqaruvi
title.en: Residential complexes, business centres and bazaars

value.uz: Ijara va kommunal toʻlovlar, taʼmir arizalari va eʼlonlar bitta ilovada; boshqaruv qarzdorlar va ochiq arizalarni koʻrib turadi.
value.ru: Аренда и коммунальные платежи, заявки на ремонт и объявления в одном приложении; управляющая компания видит должников и открытые заявки.
value.en: Rent and utility payments, repair requests and announcements in one app, with debtors and open requests visible to management.

scope.mvp: Units and tenants or residents; monthly charges; payments through Click or Payme; repair requests with technicians; announcements; Telegram bot or app.
scope.full: Meter readings; intercom and access passes; parking; resident voting; contractor management; financial reports for owners; stall rent for bazaars and malls.

value.uz: Buyurtma, mashina, haydovchi va hujjatlar bitta tizimda; yuk Oʻzbekistondan Qozogʻiston, Rossiya yoki Xitoygacha kuzatiladi, har reys foydasi koʻrinadi.
value.ru: Заказы, машины, водители и документы в одной системе; груз отслеживается из Узбекистана до Казахстана, России или Китая, прибыль каждого рейса видна.
value.en: Orders, trucks, drivers and documents in one system, cargo tracked from Uzbekistan to Kazakhstan, Russia or China, and the profit of every trip visible.

scope.mvp: Orders and quotes; own and hired trucks; trip planning; driver app with statuses and photos; documents (CMR, waybills); GPS tracking link.
scope.full: Client portal; rates and fuel norms; expenses per trip; customs and border statuses; e-invoices; profit per client and route; freight exchange integration.

value.uz: Har bir dorixonadagi qoldiq, yaroqlilik muddati va markirovka nazoratda; muddati tugayotgan dori vaqtida boshqa filialga oʻtkaziladi.
value.ru: Остатки, сроки годности и маркировка в каждой аптеке под контролем; препараты с истекающим сроком вовремя перемещаются в другой филиал.
value.en: Stock, expiry dates and marking codes in every pharmacy under control, with near-expiry medicines moved to another branch in time.

scope.mvp: POS with fiscal module; stock by batch and expiry; Asl belgisi scanning; transfers between branches; supplier orders; central dashboard.
scope.full: Online ordering and reservation through Telegram or an app; search for equivalent medicines; loyalty; purchase forecasting; register for prescription and controlled medicines; marketing agreements with manufacturers.

value.uz: Mijoz arizani telefondan beradi, MyID va kredit tarixi bir necha daqiqada tekshiriladi; qaror va toʻlov jadvali avtomatik.
value.ru: Клиент подаёт заявку с телефона, MyID и кредитная история проверяются за минуты; решение и график платежей формируются автоматически.
value.en: Customers apply from their phones, MyID and credit history are checked in minutes, and the decision and payment schedule come automatically.

scope.mvp: Application flow (web, app or Telegram); MyID verification; KATM credit report; scoring rules; contract with e-signature; card linking for repayments; back office for underwriters.
scope.full: Checkout for partner merchants; machine-learning scoring; collections workflow with AI calls; loan servicing and restructuring; Central Bank reporting; antifraud.

solutions.notes: Lending needs a licence held by your organisation; we build to the regulator's requirements.

title.uz: Onlayn sugʻurta: polis, toʻlov, zarar arizasi
title.ru: Онлайн-страхование: полис, оплата, заявление об убытке

value.uz: Mijoz majburiy avtosugʻurta yoki boshqa polisni bir necha daqiqada onlayn sotib oladi, zarar haqidagi arizani foto bilan ilovadan yuboradi.
value.ru: Клиент за несколько минут покупает онлайн обязательное автострахование или другой полис и подаёт заявление об убытке с фото из приложения.
value.en: Customers buy compulsory motor insurance or another policy online in minutes and file claims with photos from the app.

scope.mvp: Online purchase of one product with price calculation; MyID or OneID; payment; electronic policy delivery; integration with the policy registry required for that product.
scope.full: Several products; claims with photos and status tracking; partner channels (banks, car dealers); renewals and reminders; antifraud checks; reports.

title.uz: Davlat xaridlari: tenderlarni kuzatish va ariza tayyorlash
title.ru: Госзакупки: мониторинг тендеров и подготовка заявок
title.en: Government tenders: monitoring and bid preparation

value.uz: Kompaniyangizga mos tender va tanlovlar har kuni Telegramga keladi; muddatlar va hujjatlar roʻyxati esdan chiqmaydi.
value.ru: Подходящие вашей компании тендеры и отборы каждый день приходят в Telegram; сроки и списки документов не забываются.
value.en: Tenders that fit your company arrive in Telegram every day, and deadlines and document lists are never missed.

scope.mvp: Collection of public tenders from the national procurement portals; AI matching to your profile and keywords; daily Telegram digest; deadline calendar.
scope.full: Document checklist per tender; draft bid documents from templates; price history from published results; team workflow and approvals; win and loss analytics.

solutions.notes: Uses public data only; bids are submitted by your own staff with your E-IMZO key.

title.uz: Toʻyxona va banket zallari uchun bron tizimi
title.ru: Система бронирования для тойхан и банкетных залов
title.en: Booking system for wedding and banquet halls

value.uz: Sana, zal, menyu va avans bitta kalendarda; bir kunga ikki toʻy tushib qolmaydi, mijoz eslatma va hisobni Telegramda oladi.
value.ru: Дата, зал, меню и предоплата в одном календаре; двойных броней не бывает, клиент получает напоминания и счёт в Telegram.
value.en: Date, hall, menu and deposit in one calendar, no double bookings, and clients get reminders and the bill in Telegram.

scope.mvp: Hall calendar; bookings with deposits; menu packages priced by guest count; contracts; Telegram reminders; payment tracking.
scope.full: Several halls and branches; kitchen and purchase planning from bookings; staff scheduling; decoration and service extras; online availability on your website; reports.

title.uz: Fitnes klub va sport maktabi tizimi
title.ru: Система для фитнес-клуба и спортивной школы
title.en: System for fitness clubs and sports schools

value.uz: Abonementlar, QR yoki Face ID orqali kirish, mashgʻulotga yozilish va murabbiylar jadvali bitta tizimda; abonementi tugayotgan mijozga eslatma ketadi.
value.ru: Абонементы, вход по QR или Face ID, запись на тренировки и расписание тренеров в одной системе; клиенту с заканчивающимся абонементом уходит напоминание.
value.en: Memberships, entry by QR or face ID, class booking and trainer schedules in one system, with reminders to members whose pass is running out.

scope.mvp: Memberships and freezes; entry by QR or face terminal; class timetable and booking in Telegram; payments with Click or Payme; front-desk panel.
scope.full: Member app; trainer pay; personal training packages; booking of football pitches and courts; retention analytics; several clubs.

title.en: System for car service centres and car washes

value.uz: Mijoz vaqtga yoziladi, buyurtma-naryad va ehtiyot qismlar tizimda, mashina tarixi saqlanadi; navbatdagi texnik xizmat haqida eslatma oʻzi ketadi.
value.ru: Клиент записывается на время, заказ-наряд и запчасти в системе, история машины сохраняется; напоминание о следующем ТО уходит само.
value.en: Customers book a time, work orders and parts live in the system, every car's history is kept, and service reminders go out on their own.

scope.mvp: Booking through Telegram; work orders with labour and parts; parts stock; car history by plate number; payments and receipts; mechanic pay.
scope.full: Several branches; supplier orders; customer app; loyalty; plate recognition at the gate; profit per service and per mechanic.
